announcements.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports Nextflow version pinning at run time
announcements.summary: AWS HealthOmics now allows customers to specify and pin specific Nextflow engine versions (22.04, 23.10, 24.10, 25.10, 26.04) at run time through the StartRun API's new engine-settings parameter. This feature enables controlled migration by giving customers explicit control over which Nextflow version their workflows use at execution time. AWS HealthOmics is a HIPAA-eligible service designed for healthcare and life sciences customers.

announcements.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports Nextflow version 26.04
announcements.summary: AWS HealthOmics now supports Nextflow version 26.04, bringing new features including record types, strict syntax parser, workflow output summaries, and agent logging mode to help healthcare and life sciences customers accelerate scientific breakthroughs. AWS HealthOmics is a HIPAA-eligible service that provides fully managed bioinformatics workflows at scale. The strict syntax parser is now enabled by default in this version to help customers save time and improve workflow reliability.

announcements.title: Quick Research now supports customer managed keys
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) through AWS Key Management Service (KMS), allowing organizations to encrypt their data using their own encryption keys. This enhancement provides greater security control and compliance capabilities for organizations with strict data protection requirements. The feature includes comprehensive audit capabilities through AWS CloudTrail integration, enabling customers to trace all data access for security monitoring.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick now supports VPC connectivity for MCP connections
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight now supports VPC connectivity, allowing enterprise customers to connect their privately hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers through Amazon Virtual Private Cloud instead of only through public internet connections. This enhancement enables organizations with MCP servers on private networks to securely integrate with QuickSight's AI assistant capabilities. The update expands QuickSight's enterprise functionality by supporting private network architectures that many organizations require for security and compliance reasons.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker adds permissions boundaries for SCP compliance
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports custom IAM permissions boundaries to help organizations comply with Service Control Policies (SCPs) that require permissions boundaries on all IAM roles. When users create projects, SageMaker automatically provisions three IAM roles (project user, Bedrock service, and Bedrock Lambda execution roles) that can now incorporate these administrator-specified permissions boundaries, allowing organizations to adopt the service without compromising their existing security requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now allows you to bring your own secrets with AWS Secrets Manager
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports customer-managed secrets through direct integration with AWS Secrets Manager, allowing users to reference existing secret ARNs in Credential Providers. This replaces the previous service-managed approach and enables customers to apply resource tags, use customer-managed encryption keys (CMK), and implement organization-specific governance policies on their secrets.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances offer up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, delivering the highest performance among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8azn instances are now available in Europe (Ireland) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8azn instances are now available in the Europe (Ireland) Region, featuring fifth-generation AMD EPYC processors with the highest maximum CPU frequency of 5GHz in the cloud. These general-purpose instances offer up to 2x better compute performance compared to M5zn instances and 24% higher performance than M8a instances.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports EFA-only network interfaces
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports EFA-only network interfaces, allowing users to configure dedicated Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) devices without traditional Elastic Network Adapter (ENA) for IP networking. This enhancement enables better scaling of AI/ML clusters on SageMaker HyperPod's resilient, high-performance infrastructure designed for model development with built-in fault tolerance and automated recovery.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers troubleshooting skills for AI coding assistants
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod has introduced new troubleshooting skills that integrate expert-level AI/ML cluster diagnostics directly into popular AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Kiro. This enhancement builds on SageMaker HyperPod's existing capabilities as a purpose-built infrastructure platform for developing, training, and deploying foundation models at scale with built-in fault tolerance and automated recovery features.

announcements.title: AWS Direct Connect now supports VIF Rate Limiters to help prevent network congestion
announcements.summary: AWS Direct Connect has introduced VIF Rate Limiters for dedicated connections, allowing customers to set maximum bandwidth allocations for up to 10 Virtual Interfaces (VIFs) to prevent network congestion. This feature helps protect against unexpected traffic spikes on one VIF from consuming all available bandwidth and impacting other workloads on the same connection. Bandwidth limits can be configured in increments ranging from 50 Mbps to 1.6 Tbps.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock adds Amazon CloudWatch metrics for OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports Amazon CloudWatch metrics for monitoring inference traffic to the bedrock-mantle endpoint, which provides OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. This extends the same monitoring capabilities that customers already have for the bedrock-runtime endpoint to these additional API formats. The enhancement allows customers to maintain consistent observability across their generative AI applications regardless of which API format they're using.

announcements.title: Amazon SES now offers inbox placement metrics and blocklist monitoring
announcements.summary: Amazon SES has launched new deliverability features that provide customers with inbox placement metrics and blocklist monitoring capabilities. The service now shows the percentage of messages landing in spam folders using industry data samples and alerts users when their domains or IP addresses appear on public email sender blocklists. These features help customers better understand their email deliverability performance and optimize their sending practices to improve inbox placement rates.

announcements.title: AWS End User Messaging RCS for Business now available in 20 additional countries
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded its End User Messaging RCS for Business service to 20 additional countries, bringing the total supported countries to 22. Businesses can now send verified, branded RCS messages to customers across Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific regions including major markets like Germany, France, UK, Brazil, and Mexico. The service integrates with the existing SendTextMessage API for easy implementation.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports scheduling tasks up to 90 days in advance
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Customer now allows users to schedule tasks up to 90 days in advance, enabling better planning and tracking of long-term follow-up work. This feature helps organizations automatically route tasks to appropriate teams at scheduled times with relevant context, such as scheduling insurance claim follow-ups or repair visits. Tasks can be scheduled through the StartTaskContact API, flows, or the agent workspace.

announcements.title: AWS Shield Advanced introduces DDoS attack flow logs
announcements.summary: AWS Shield Advanced now provides DDoS attack flow logs that offer packet-level visibility into traffic targeting protected resources during distributed denial-of-service attacks. These logs capture detailed information such as source/destination IP addresses, ports, protocols, and packet counts, and can be published to Amazon S3, CloudWatch Logs, or Data Firehose for forensic analysis and compliance purposes.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift Serverless now offers 4-RPU Minimum Capacity in 7 additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift Serverless now supports a reduced minimum capacity configuration of 4 Redshift Processing Units (RPUs) in seven additional AWS regions, including Asia Pacific (Hong Kong and Seoul), Canada (Central), Europe (London), South America (Sao Paulo), and both AWS GovCloud regions. This lower entry point (with each RPU providing 16 GB of memory) allows customers to start with smaller data warehouse configurations and pay only for actual workload duration.

announcements.title: AWS Interconnect - multicloud now offers a free 500 Mbps tier
announcements.summary: AWS has launched AWS Interconnect - multicloud, which now includes a free 500 Mbps tier for private connectivity between AWS and other public cloud providers. This service is designed to support customers adopting multicloud strategies by simplifying how cloud service providers offer managed, resilient private connections. The offering uses an open specification to enable seamless multicloud workload connectivity.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports April 2026 Release Update and Supplemental Patch Bundle
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports the April 2026 Release Update for Oracle Database versions 19c and 21c, as well as the corresponding Supplemental Patch Bundle for version 19c. AWS recommends upgrading to this release as it includes important security updates for Oracle database products. Additionally, Oracle has renamed the Oracle Spatial Patch Bundle to Supplemental Patch Bundle (SPB) starting with the April 2026 releases.

announcements.title: Oracle Database@AWS is now available in twenty AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Oracle Database@AWS has expanded to eight additional AWS Regions, bringing the total availability to twenty regions worldwide. The service provides customers access to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) managed Oracle Exadata systems directly within AWS data centers. This expansion particularly benefits customers in Europe, South America, and Asia Pacific who require in-region data residency compliance.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Tables are now available in two additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Tables, which provide built-in Apache Iceberg support for streamlined tabular data storage, are now available in the Asia Pacific (Taipei) and Asia Pacific (New Zealand) regions. This service offers the first cloud object store with integrated Apache Iceberg capabilities and automatically performs table maintenance to optimize query performance and reduce storage costs. The Apache Iceberg standard ensures compatibility with both AWS and third-party analytics tools.

announcements.title: Monitor AWS Budgets directly in Billing and Cost Management Dashboards with new Budgets widget
announcements.summary: AWS Billing and Cost Management now supports Budgets widgets that can be added directly to BCM Dashboards, allowing users to monitor AWS Budgets alongside other cost reports in a single customized view. This eliminates the need to navigate to separate console pages to review budget performance, streamlining cost management workflows.

announcements.title: AWS IoT Core adds APIs for MQTT connection management
announcements.summary: AWS IoT Core has introduced two new APIs - GetConnection and ListSubscriptions - that provide visibility into MQTT client connection and subscription information for IoT devices. These APIs enable developers to troubleshoot connectivity issues, monitor client behavior, and audit connection patterns across their device fleets. The GetConnection API specifically retrieves detailed connection information to help with device connection management.

announcements.title: AWS Organizations emits CloudTrail events for account membership changes
announcements.summary: AWS Organizations now automatically logs CloudTrail events (AccountJoinedOrganization and AccountDepartedOrganization) to the management account whenever accounts join or leave an organization. This enhancement provides security teams and cloud administrators with better visibility into organizational membership changes, helping them detect unauthorized activities and potential security incidents that could previously go unnoticed.

announcements.title: AWS announces general availability of the next generation of AWS Resilience Hub
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of the next-generation AWS Resilience Hub, a centralized console tool designed to help platform engineering and site reliability teams assess and improve the resilience of critical workloads on AWS. The updated version introduces new features including an enhanced application model, dependency discovery capabilities, and AI-powered failure mode analysis to better help organizations meet their resilience objectives.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands generative AI-powered post-contact summaries to eight new languages
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Customer has expanded its generative AI-powered post-contact summaries to support eight new language families (Portuguese, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean) plus non-US English variations. This enhancement allows the AI to automatically generate concise summaries of customer interactions in multiple languages with locally appropriate spelling and terminology. The feature helps agents and managers by providing quick, accessible summaries of customer contacts across diverse linguistic markets.

announcements.title: Claude Opus 4.8 is now available on AWS
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Claude Opus 4.8, Anthropic's most advanced publicly available AI model, designed for developers and enterprises building production AI applications. The model offers significant improvements in autonomous coding, professional knowledge work, and long-running tasks with enhanced reasoning capabilities and consistency. Claude Opus 4.8 can perform extended autonomous operations and approaches coding tasks like an engineer by reading codebases comprehensively and planning before making edits.

announcements.title: DynamoDB Streams now supports AWS PrivateLink for FIPS endpoints in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports AWS PrivateLink for FIPS endpoints in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, enabling government agencies and organizations with federal compliance requirements to establish secure, private connectivity. This enhancement allows these organizations to access DynamoDB Streams' real-time data processing capabilities while maintaining strict security and compliance standards required for federal workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications adds support for Windows Desktop OS
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports Windows Desktop operating systems through a Bring Your Own License (BYOL) model. This allows customers to use their existing Windows Desktop licenses to run Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise in the cloud, providing a consistent desktop experience across on-premises and virtual environments.

announcements.title: The next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless is now generally available
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, a fully managed search and vector engine specifically designed for building AI agents. The new version auto-scales 20x faster than its predecessor and can provision resources in seconds to handle unpredictable agentic workflows. With scale-to-zero capabilities and pay-per-usage pricing, customers can save up to 60% compared to traditional provisioned OpenSearch costs.

announcements.title: AWS IoT Core now supports direct messaging for point-to-point communication
announcements.summary: AWS IoT Core has introduced direct messaging capabilities that allow point-to-point communication with any connected IoT device, eliminating the need to publish messages through topics. This new feature provides improved visibility into message delivery status and reduces messaging costs compared to the previous topic-based approach.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of P6-B200 instances on SageMaker Notebook Instances
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances on SageMaker Notebook Instances in the US East (N. Virginia) region. These instances feature 8 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with 1440 GB of high-bandwidth memory and 5th Generation Intel Xeon processors, delivering up to 2x better AI training performance compared to P5en instances. The P6-B200 instances are designed for interactive development and fine-tuning of large foundation models.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock expands support for Service Quotas
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports viewing inference quotas for the bedrock-mantle endpoint through AWS Service Quotas, providing customers with a consistent way to monitor service limits. This enhancement allows users to track quotas for the bedrock-mantle endpoint using the same familiar interface they already use for other AWS services and the bedrock-runtime endpoint.

announcements.title: SageMaker Notebook Instances now support P5.4xl instance types
announcements.summary: AWS has announced general availability of Amazon EC2 P5.4xl instances for SageMaker notebook instances, powered by NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs. These instances deliver up to 4x faster performance compared to previous-generation GPU instances and can reduce ML model training costs by up to 40%. The P5.4xl instances are optimized for deep learning and high performance computing applications.

announcements.title: SageMaker Notebook Instances now support P5en.48xl instance types
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Notebook Instances now support P5en.48xl instance types, which feature 8 H200 GPUs that offer 1.7x more GPU memory and 1.4x higher memory bandwidth compared to H100 GPUs in P5 instances. These instances are paired with custom 4th Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and Gen5 PCIe connectivity, providing up to 4x the bandwidth between CPU and GPU to enhance AI training performance.

announcements.title: Amazon EMR now supports Apache Spark 4.0.2 in general availability
announcements.summary: Amazon EMR now offers general availability support for Apache Spark 4.0.2 across all deployment models. The update introduces enhanced data pipeline capabilities with ANSI SQL and VARIANT data types, fine-grained access control at row and column levels, improved compliance through Apache Iceberg v3 table format, and faster deployment of real-time streaming applications.

announcements.title: AWS Glue large and memory optimized workers now available in Europe (Spain) Region
announcements.summary: AWS Glue has expanded its worker options in the Europe (Spain) Region by introducing large and memory-optimized workers to handle more complex data processing workloads. The new offerings include two general compute workers (G.12X and G.16X) and four memory-optimized workers (R.1X, R.2X, R.4X, and R.8X). These enhanced worker types enable customers to perform more complex data transforms, aggregations, joins, and queries while processing larger data volumes more efficiently.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Customer now uses generative AI to automatically evaluate self-service interactions
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Customer now uses generative AI to automatically evaluate self-service interactions, allowing managers to define custom evaluation criteria in natural language. The system can assess interaction quality based on criteria like whether customer issues were resolved by the AI agent, and provides detailed reasoning for its evaluations. This feature gives managers aggregated insights to help improve overall customer experience through automated quality assessment.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm clusters now support specifying minimum capacity requirements with continuous provisioning
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now allows users to specify minimum capacity requirements (MinCount) for Slurm-orchestrated clusters with continuous provisioning. This feature ensures that training workloads have a guaranteed minimum number of nodes available before starting, while still allowing the cluster to provision additional capacity asynchronously in the background. This provides both the flexibility of quick job starts and the reliability needed for workloads that require specific minimum resource thresholds.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL now supports integration with Kiro Powers
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition now integrates with Kiro Powers, a repository of curated Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and development tools that provide AI agent assistance for faster application development. This integration combines direct database connectivity with Aurora MySQL and pre-validated development resources from Kiro partners to accelerate specialized software development and deployment.

announcements.title: AWS Backup adds OTP verification for Multi-party approval on logically air-gapped vaults
announcements.summary: AWS Backup has enhanced security for logically air-gapped vaults by requiring one-time password (OTP) verification for Multi-party approval actions. Approvers must now enter a six-digit code sent to their registered email address in AWS IAM Identity Center when voting on approval requests. This additional security layer ensures only verified approvers can authorize protected vault operations and applies automatically to all existing vaults.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 X8i instances, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS, are now available in Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), and AWS GovCloud (US-West) regions. These SAP-certified instances deliver up to 43% higher performance, 1.5x more memory capacity (up to 6TB), and 3.3x more memory bandwidth compared to similar Intel processors in the cloud, offering the highest performance among comparable Intel-based cloud instances.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS now supports ENA Express for Multi-AZ replication
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ instances now support ENA Express, which uses AWS's Scalable Reliable Datagram (SRD) protocol to enhance cross-Availability Zone replication performance. This improvement delivers up to 25 Gbps single-flow bandwidth and reduces latency variability through advanced congestion control and multi-pathing capabilities for Multi-AZ deployments.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) Region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These instances provide up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, along with up to 20% better overall performance.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) Region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These instances deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, offering the highest performance and fastest memory bandwidth among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon VPC IPAM now supports tags on IPAM pool allocations
announcements.summary: Amazon VPC IP Address Manager (IPAM) now supports adding tags to IPAM pool allocations, allowing customers to organize and manage individual IP address allocations using consistent tagging workflows. This enhancement enables better governance and access control for IP allocations across AWS environments, with tags applicable to both new and existing allocations.

announcements.title: Amazon GuardDuty Malware Protection for AWS Backup supports Amazon S3 continuous backups
announcements.summary: Amazon GuardDuty Malware Protection now supports scanning Amazon S3 continuous backups for malware, allowing users to identify clean recovery points across their entire backup timeline. The service offers both full and incremental scanning options within backup plans, plus on-demand scans for any restorable point in time. Users can query malware scan status at any point within their continuous backup timeline to ensure safe data recovery.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds interactive interface for managing Feature Store in IAM Domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now provides an interactive, code-free interface for managing Feature Store within IAM domains, making feature group creation and management accessible without programming requirements. This update enables data scientists, ML engineers, and business analysts to collaborate on feature management tasks from a unified environment, streamlining the process of handling ML model inputs used for training and inference.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker expands domain management across domain types
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has expanded its domain management capabilities to support both Identity Center-based and IAM-based domains outside of the AWS console. This allows administrators to create and manage projects, configure workforce identity, manage users and permissions, and set networking properties across all domain types. Previously, these domain management features were only available for IAM-based domains.

announcements.title: New agentic migration assessment capabilities now available with AWS Transform
announcements.summary: AWS Transform has launched new agentic migration assessment capabilities that enable users to perform what-if scenarios, customize assumptions, and conduct comprehensive TCO assessments. The enhanced features support flexible file formats including RVTools exports, CMDB data, and AWS Transform discovery tool exports to help build migration business cases more efficiently. These capabilities are designed to accelerate migration decision-making processes for organizations planning their cloud transitions.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker adds business metadata and governance in IAM-based domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now enables customers to add business context and metadata to their AWS Glue Data Catalog tables within IAM-based domains, including business names, descriptions, and documentation. The service includes AI-generated metadata capabilities that automatically produce business names and descriptions, significantly reducing the manual effort required to catalog large numbers of tables. This enhancement brings improved data governance and business context management to SageMaker's IAM-based domain users.

announcements.title: AWS Security Agent adds verification scripts for pentest findings
announcements.summary: AWS Security Agent now automatically generates verification scripts for penetration test findings, allowing security teams to independently reproduce and validate discovered vulnerabilities. This replaces the previous manual process of following reproduction steps from finding details. Teams can simply download the generated scripts, configure environment variables, and execute them against target systems to streamline vulnerability verification.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal now supports WorkSpace Migration for Linux WorkSpaces
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal now supports WorkSpace Migration for all Linux operating systems, enabling customers to seamlessly migrate between different Linux distributions or upgrade to newer OS versions. The migration process is automated and preserves user data from the home directory during the transition.

announcements.title: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) expands to Asia Pacific (Malaysia) and Asia Pacific (Thailand) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) has expanded its availability to the Asia Pacific (Malaysia) and Asia Pacific (Thailand) regions. This expansion enables customers in these regions to build Cassandra-compatible applications with reduced latency while maintaining data residency compliance by keeping their data within the local region.

announcements.title: AWS Clean Rooms now supports mutable payment configurations for collaborations
announcements.summary: AWS Clean Rooms now allows customers to modify payment configurations for collaboration members after a collaboration has been created, providing greater flexibility in managing payment responsibilities. Customers can now specify which partners are authorized to pay for different types of costs, including SQL queries, PySpark jobs, ML model training and inference, and synthetic data generation. This feature gives organizations more control and adaptability when developing new use cases with their collaboration partners.

announcements.title: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Datadog vended keys and Snowflake Programmatic Access Tokens
announcements.summary: AWS Secrets Manager now supports automatic rotation of Datadog keys (API keys, Application keys, and admin credentials) and Snowflake Programmatic Access Tokens through its managed external secrets feature. This capability allows customers to automatically rotate third-party credentials directly from AWS Secrets Manager with native integration to these services.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights adds new query commands and functions
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights has added 13 new query commands and functions that enhance log analysis capabilities. These new tools enable users to perform advanced operations like string manipulation, field encoding/decoding, parsing non-JSON formats, and calculating geographic distances. The update provides more powerful ways to query, transform, and analyze logs to derive deeper insights from log data.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C7i-flex, M7i-flex & M7i instances now available in Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) region
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 C7i-flex, M7i-flex, and M7i instances in the Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) region, powered by custom 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors (Sapphire Rapids). These AWS-exclusive custom processors deliver up to 15% better performance compared to similar x86-based Intel processors used by other cloud providers, with the flex instances offering improved price-performance benefits for most workloads.

announcements.title: SageMaker Unified Studio automates Glue connector provisioning for cross-subnet job retries
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now automatically creates Glue connections for job retries across different subnets, enhancing data pipeline resilience and reducing unplanned downtime. This automation eliminates the need for manual configuration of backup connectors or engineer intervention during subnet failures. The feature helps organizations maintain business-critical data pipelines and meet their service level agreements more reliably.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports OpenAI-compatible APIs for inference endpoints
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports OpenAI-compatible APIs, allowing developers to use familiar tools like OpenAI SDK, LangChain, and Strands Agents with their SageMaker endpoints. The integration requires only changing the endpoint URL with no need for custom code, SDK wrappers, or rewrites, making it seamless to switch between OpenAI and SageMaker services.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 8.4  is now generally available
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition now supports MySQL 8.4, a Long Term Support (LTS) version, with compatibility for community MySQL 8.4.7. The release introduces aligned version numbering so Aurora versions now match their corresponding community MySQL versions, and Aurora automatically manages underlying patches to simplify operations. Aurora MySQL now commits to supporting major versions within 12 months of their community MySQL release.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server now supports the latest General Distribution Release (GDR) updates, including SQL Server 2019 CU32+GDR and SQL Server 2022 CU24+GDR. These updates address security vulnerabilities CVE-2026-32167 and CVE-2026-32176.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock expands support for request-level usage attribution
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports request-level usage attribution, allowing customers to track model inference usage for specific teams, applications, environments, and experiments through the InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream APIs. This feature provides detailed visibility into organizational usage patterns, enabling better cost optimization and internal reporting. The capability requires no additional resource provisioning.

announcements.title: AWS Security Hub now uncovers identity risks from unused access
announcements.summary: AWS Security Hub now integrates identity risk management into its unified security console, allowing central security teams to detect unused IAM permissions, roles, and credentials across their entire AWS organization. This new capability eliminates the need to toggle between multiple tools to manage identity risks across hundreds of accounts. The feature helps security teams identify and reduce identity-related security risks at scale from a single, centralized location.

announcements.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) Serverless is now available on DocumentDB 8.0
announcements.summary: Amazon DocumentDB Serverless is now available on version 8.0, offering automatic scaling that adjusts capacity based on application demand and can provide up to 90% cost savings compared to peak capacity provisioning. DocumentDB 8.0 delivers significant performance improvements with up to 7x better query latency and 5x improved compression ratios, while adding compatibility with MongoDB API version 6.

announcements.title: Security Hub Extended expands to 21 curated partner solutions across 9 categories
announcements.summary: AWS Security Hub Extended has expanded to include 21 curated partner security solutions across 9 categories, adding new vendors like SentinelOne, CyberArk, Sublime, Varonis, LayerX, Native Security, and Zenity. The expansion provides enterprises with greater flexibility in selecting security solutions that meet their specific requirements, all with pay-as-you-go pricing and consolidated AWS billing.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports data quality rule authoring and evaluation
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now includes data quality rule authoring and evaluation capabilities powered by AWS Glue Data Quality. Users can define quality rules, run evaluations, and view results directly within the platform for both stored catalog data and data moving through Visual ETL jobs. This feature helps detect data quality issues early to prevent bad data from impacting data lakes and downstream analytics or machine learning processes.

announcements.title: AWS announces ExtendDB, an open source DynamoDB-compatible adapter
announcements.summary: AWS has announced ExtendDB version 0.1, an open source project that provides a DynamoDB-compatible API with pluggable storage backends. This tool allows developers to use DynamoDB's programming model in environments where the managed DynamoDB service isn't available, such as on local developer laptops. ExtendDB essentially brings DynamoDB's NoSQL database interface to self-hosted and offline development scenarios.

announcements.title: AWS Billing Conductor Improves Account Visibility with Billing Transfer Inventory
announcements.summary: AWS Billing Conductor Console now provides a new billing transfer inventory feature that helps customers identify accounts that have accepted billing transfer invitations but still don't have access to pro forma billing data. This enhancement improves account billing visibility by helping customers detect and close gaps in their billing coverage. The feature works in conjunction with billing groups configured through AWS Billing Conductor to ensure accounts can properly access cost data across billing and cost management tools.

announcements.title: ECS supports native integration with Amazon EBS volumes in GovCloud Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS now supports native integration with Amazon EBS volumes in AWS GovCloud Regions, allowing containers to mount EBS storage for data-intensive applications like ETL jobs, media transcoding, and ML inference workloads. This feature enables ECS to automatically provision, manage, and de-provision EBS volumes with each task launch, simplifying storage management for serverless container deployments.

announcements.title: Announcing the general availability of a new AWS Local Zone in Istanbul, Türkiye
announcements.summary: AWS has launched a new Local Zone in Istanbul, Turkey, bringing AWS infrastructure closer to end users in the region. This deployment enables organizations to achieve single-digit millisecond latency and meet local data residency requirements by storing and backing up data within Turkey. The Local Zone extends core AWS services including compute, storage, and networking to the Istanbul metropolitan area.

announcements.title: AWS Transfer Family web apps now support federated permissions with IAM Identity Center across AWS Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Transfer Family web apps now support federated permissions with IAM Identity Center across multiple AWS Regions, whereas previously they were limited to the Region where IAM Identity Center was enabled. This enhancement leverages IAM Identity Center's multi-Region replication capability, allowing users to create Transfer Family web apps in additional Regions to reduce latency and improve reliability.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports data capture for inference workloads
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now includes data capture functionality for inference workloads, allowing customers to automatically record both input requests and output responses from their deployed models. This capability enables organizations to monitor model performance, meet compliance requirements, debug production issues, and conduct offline analysis of their generative AI and machine learning models.

announcements.title: Amazon MWAA now supports Apache Airflow 3.2
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA) now supports Apache Airflow version 3.2, the latest major release of the open-source workflow orchestration framework. This update introduces new data-aware scheduling capabilities and developer productivity improvements for teams building and operating data pipelines on AWS. MWAA continues to provide a managed service that allows users to run Apache Airflow at scale without managing the underlying infrastructure.

announcements.title: Amazon Inspector is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon Inspector, AWS's automated vulnerability management service, is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region. The service continuously scans AWS workloads including EC2 instances, container images, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure. This regional expansion extends Amazon Inspector's security coverage to help customers in the Taipei region better protect their AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS introduces pause and continue controls for service deployments
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS now offers pause and continue controls for service deployments, allowing users to halt deployments at critical stages and resume them when ready. This feature enables manual approval workflows, operational checks, integration tests, and custom automation while maintaining native ECS deployment strategies with managed traffic shifting. The controls provide interactive decision points during the deployment process for better operational control and validation.

announcements.title: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports dual-stack connectivity (IPv6 and IPv4)
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports dual-stack connectivity, allowing workspaces to communicate over both IPv4 and IPv6 protocols for Grafana version 10.4 or later. This feature simplifies network management by eliminating the need to handle overlapping address spaces in VPCs and enables customers to migrate to IPv6 while maintaining connectivity to their Grafana workspaces.

announcements.title: AWS Management Console now displays AWS Local Zones in the Region Selector
announcements.summary: AWS has updated the Management Console to include AWS Local Zones in the Region selector, providing a unified experience for managing both Regions and Local Zones from the top navigation. Customers can now access a dedicated Local Zones tab that displays all their opted-in Local Zones in one place, making it easier to navigate and manage resources across AWS's global infrastructure.

announcements.title: AWS Glue zero-ETL is now available in Asia Pacific (Mumbai) region
announcements.summary: AWS Glue zero-ETL integrations are now available in the Asia Pacific (Mumbai) region, allowing customers to simplify data pipelines and reduce latency for analytics and machine learning workloads. These fully managed integrations minimize the need to build traditional ETL data pipelines for common data ingestion and replication tasks, helping customers accelerate time-to-insight.

announcements.title: Amazon Lightsail CDN distributions now support IPv6-only instances as origins
announcements.summary: Amazon Lightsail CDN distributions now support using IPv6-only instances as origin servers, enabling customers to deliver content globally with low latency and high transfer speeds. This allows customers to run cost-effective IPv6-only instances for their websites and applications while still serving content to all end users, including those on networks without IPv6 support.

announcements.title: Amazon EVS enables support for 32 hosts per environment
announcements.summary: Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) has doubled its capacity limit, now supporting up to 32 ESXi hosts per environment compared to the previous 16-host limit. This enhancement provides greater flexibility for configuring VMware Cloud Foundation domains and clusters, allowing users to organize hosts across single large clusters, multiple smaller clusters, or custom combinations. Users can access this increased capacity by submitting a service quota increase request.

announcements.title: AWS SAM CLI adds AWS CloudFormation Language Extensions support to accelerate local serverless development
announcements.summary: AWS SAM CLI now supports AWS CloudFormation Language Extensions, allowing developers to reduce template duplication by defining similar resources (like Lambda functions, DynamoDB tables, or SNS topics) once and reusing them throughout their infrastructure as code templates. This enhancement maintains the full local development workflow, enabling faster serverless development by allowing local iteration without waiting for cloud deployments.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift adds ALTER TABLE for Iceberg tables and writes via the AWS Glue Data Catalog mount
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift now supports direct writes to Apache Iceberg tables through the AWS Glue Data Catalog mount and adds ALTER TABLE functionality for modifying Iceberg table schemas, partitioning, and properties. This enhancement allows users to write Redshift transformations directly to their data lake without creating external schemas, making the data accessible to any query engine. The feature is particularly beneficial for Iceberg tables integrated with AWS Lake Formation.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Studio now supports GPU capacity reservation through SageMaker Flexible Training Plans
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Studio IDEs (JupyterLab and Code Editor) now support GPU capacity reservations through SageMaker Flexible Training Plans (FTP), providing predictable access to high-performance computing resources. This new feature offers up to 65% cost savings compared to On-Demand instances while ensuring reliable GPU availability for ML workflows within budget constraints.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs announces increased query result limits
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs has increased its query result limits from 10,000 to 100,000 results for Logs Insights queries. This enhancement eliminates the need for customers to split queries into smaller time ranges and allows them to use features like patterns, visualization, and export on the expanded result set.

announcements.title: Amazon EMR Serverless is now available in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EMR Serverless has expanded its availability to six additional AWS Regions across Asia Pacific (Hyderabad, Malaysia, New Zealand, Taipei, and Thailand) and Mexico (Central). EMR Serverless is a deployment option that enables data engineers and analysts to run petabyte-scale data analytics using Apache Spark and Apache Hive applications in a simple and cost-effective manner without managing infrastructure.

announcements.title: AWS Partner Central agents now accelerates opportunity creation
announcements.summary: AWS has announced that AWS Partner Central agents now enable partners to create opportunities through natural language conversations instead of filling out complex multi-step forms. These AI-powered agents, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, help partners identify pipeline insights, advance deals with recommendations, and find funding opportunities. The update streamlines the opportunity creation process by allowing partners to simply have a conversation with the AI agent.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Cases now lets you edit related items and delete cases from the agent workspace
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Cases now allows agents to directly edit and delete related items and cases from their workspace without requiring administrator assistance. Agents can update comments, unlink incorrectly associated contacts, delete erroneous cases, and manage custom related items like orders and returns. This feature is available in US East (N. Virginia) and US West (Oregon) AWS regions.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL announces Extended Support minor versions 11.22-rds.20260224, 12.22-rds.20260224, and 13.23-rds.20260224
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL has released new Extended Support minor versions (11.22-rds.20260224, 12.22-rds.20260224, and 13.23-rds.20260224) that include critical security and bug fixes. AWS recommends upgrading to these versions to address known vulnerabilities in previous PostgreSQL versions. Amazon RDS Extended Support provides up to three additional years of security updates beyond the standard support end date for major versions.

announcements.title: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports in-place upgrade to Grafana version 12.4
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports easy in-place upgrades from version 10.4 to 12.4 through the AWS Console, SDK, or CLI. The upgrade introduces native Grafana Scenes-powered dashboards for improved performance, queryless Drilldown apps for exploring Prometheus metrics and other observability data, and enhanced CloudWatch plugin capabilities with PPL/SQL query support.

announcements.title: AWS Organizations now supports higher quotas for service control policies (SCPs)
announcements.summary: AWS Organizations has increased service control policy (SCP) quotas, doubling both the maximum number of SCPs that can be attached to a single node (from 5 to 10) and the maximum SCP size (from 5,120 to 10,240 characters). These enhanced limits enable organizations to create more detailed permissions and comprehensive security controls across their AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - multicloud connectivity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in preview
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the public preview of AWS Interconnect, a new service that provides multicloud connectivity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This service addresses the growing customer demand for multicloud strategies by enabling easier interconnection of workloads across multiple cloud environments. The solution aims to give customers greater flexibility in choosing technologies and deploying applications across different cloud platforms with improved interoperability.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront announces support for OCSP Revocation for Mutual TLS (Viewer)
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront now supports Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) revocation checking for mutual TLS (mTLS), allowing real-time validation of client certificate revocation status during connection establishment. This enhancement enables customers to verify that client certificates haven't been revoked before accepting connections, addressing key security requirements for regulated industries and zero-trust architectures.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock Introduces Advanced Prompt Optimization and Migration Tool
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has launched Advanced Prompt Optimization, a new tool designed to help customers quickly optimize and migrate prompts between models without spending days or weeks on manual testing. The tool includes built-in evaluations to prevent regressions and improve performance on underperforming tasks. This addresses a key pain point for customers who previously struggled with efficiently testing and refining prompts when switching models or seeking better performance.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront announces Passthrough Mode for mutual TLS (Viewer)
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront has introduced a new "passthrough mode" for mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication that allows client certificates to be forwarded directly to origin servers for validation, bypassing CloudFront's certificate verification. This feature enables customers with existing mTLS implementations at their origins to use CloudFront without needing to redesign their certificate validation logic for edge processing. The passthrough mode joins the existing required and optional mTLS modes already available in CloudFront.

announcements.title: Announcing general availability of Amazon EC2 M3 Ultra Mac instances
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 M3 Ultra Mac instances, which are powered by the latest Mac Studio hardware and represent the next generation of EC2 Mac instances. These instances are specifically designed for Apple developers to run demanding build and test workloads on AWS for applications across Apple platforms including iOS, macOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and Safari.

announcements.title: SageMaker AI now supports serverless model customization for Qwen3.6
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI has added serverless model customization support for Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3.6 27B parameter model, allowing users to fine-tune it using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). This builds on existing support for Qwen3.5 and other models, expanding beyond just deployment to enable customization for specific domains and workflows.

announcements.title: AWS Transform agents now available in Kiro, Claude, Cursor, and Codex
announcements.summary: AWS has announced that its Transform agents, which leverage AWS's extensive migration and modernization expertise, are now available through multiple platforms including Kiro, agent plugins, and the AWS Transform MCP server. This integration allows developers to access AWS Transform capabilities directly from their preferred development environments, whether through agentic IDEs, web consoles, or programmatic integration. The launch aims to provide developers with greater flexibility in how they consume AWS Transform services.

announcements.title: AWS Transform introduces the agent builder toolkit Kiro power for building customized transformation agents
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Kiro power, an agent builder toolkit that is part of the AWS Transform composability initiative. The toolkit allows AWS Partners and customers to build customized transformation agents tailored to their specific modernization needs that integrate seamlessly with AWS Transform. This enables Migration and Modernization Competency Partners, ISVs, and customers to create differentiated transformation solutions for their unique requirements.

announcements.title: AWS Transform now supports customer-owned artifact stores
announcements.summary: AWS Transform, an AI-powered platform for enterprise assessment, migration, and modernization, now supports customer-owned Amazon S3 buckets for storing transformation artifacts. This new feature gives customers complete control over artifact storage location and security, including the ability to use their own AWS KMS keys for encryption and manage custom access policies.

announcements.title: New models for image generation and text embeddings are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the availability of two new foundation models in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: FLUX.2-klein-base-4B for image generation from Black Forest Labs, and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B for multilingual text embeddings from Qwen. These models enable AWS customers to build creative AI applications and intelligent search systems with state-of-the-art capabilities on AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: ARC Region switch adds Lambda event source mapping execution block for event handling during failover
announcements.summary: AWS has announced a new Lambda event source mapping execution block feature for Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) Region Switch. This feature automates the coordinated failover of event streams for multi-Region workloads, helping customers running event-driven architectures achieve faster recovery times during regional outages. The enhancement specifically helps orchestrate Lambda function failovers that process event streams from services like Kinesis during disaster recovery scenarios.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports change data capture (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL now offers change data capture (CDC) in preview, allowing real-time streaming of database changes directly to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. This fully managed feature automatically captures insert, update, and delete operations as change events, eliminating the need for custom streaming pipelines and simplifying the development of event-driven applications and real-time analytics.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent now available for IAM Identity Center domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent is now available for SageMaker Unified Studio domains configured with IAM Identity Center, extending AI-powered capabilities to data analysts and engineers. The tool allows users to describe analysis goals in plain English and automatically generates working Python or SQL code, eliminating the need to manually write complex queries, joins, and aggregations across SageMaker notebooks and Query Editor environments.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now supports creating Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now supports creating Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs, enabling organizations to decentralize network and storage administration more effectively. This enhancement allows participant accounts in an AWS organization to create and manage FSx file systems in VPC subnets that have been shared by owner accounts.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances with Oracle SE2 License Included
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances with Oracle Database Standard Edition 2 (SE2) License Included, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda supports scheduled scaling for functions on Lambda Managed Instances
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda now supports scheduled scaling for functions running on Lambda Managed Instances through Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. This feature enables you to set up one-time or recurring schedules that automatically adjust your function's capacity limits before anticipated traffic spikes. The capability helps optimize both performance during peak periods and costs during low-traffic times.

announcements.title: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler adds 619 new SDK API actions, including Lambda Managed Instances
announcements.summary: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler has expanded its AWS SDK integrations by adding 619 new API actions across 13 additional services, including support for AWS Lambda Managed Instances. This serverless scheduler now enables direct invocation of a broader range of AWS services without requiring custom integration code, allowing users to create and manage billions of scheduled events across over 270 AWS services.

announcements.title: AWS Security Agent now supports full repository code reviews
announcements.summary: AWS has released a new full repository code review capability for AWS Security Agent that performs comprehensive, context-aware security analysis of entire codebases. Unlike traditional static analysis tools that rely on pattern matching, this feature analyzes application architecture, trust boundaries, and data flows to identify systemic vulnerabilities that other tools might miss. The scanner provides detailed vulnerability reports when issues are detected.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store now supports SageMaker Python SDK V3
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store now supports the SageMaker Python SDK v3, bringing new capabilities for Lake Formation access controls and Apache Iceberg table properties configuration. The updated SDK provides data scientists with modern, modular interfaces to manage feature groups with fine-grained access control and optimized offline storage. This enhancement improves the management of the fully managed repository used for storing, sharing, and managing machine learning model features.

announcements.title: Karpenter now supports Amazon Application Recovery Controller zonal shift
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS now supports Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift and zonal autoshift when using Karpenter for compute provisioning. This integration allows Kubernetes applications to automatically shift network traffic away from impaired Availability Zones, improving application availability and recovery coordination across AWS Regions and AZs.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift launches RG instances powered by AWS Graviton
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has launched RG instances, a new generation of provisioned cluster nodes powered by AWS Graviton processors that deliver up to 2.4x faster performance than previous RA3 instances at 30% lower cost per vCPU. These instances include Redshift's custom vectorized query engine that can process Apache Iceberg and Parquet data directly on cluster nodes, enabling SQL analytics across both data warehouse and data lake workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront Premium flat-rate plan now supports configurable usage allowances
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront has updated its Premium flat-rate plan to offer multiple configurable usage tiers, ranging from 500 million to 6 billion requests and 50 TB to 600 TB monthly. This replaces the previous single-tier system and allows customers to scale self-service without needing to contact AWS for custom pricing. The change makes flat-rate plans accessible to enterprises and mid-sized businesses that were previously ineligible due to higher baseline traffic requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports embedding Cases and Customer Profiles in custom agent applications
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now allows developers to embed Cases and Customer Profiles directly into custom agent applications using the Amazon Connect SDK. This integration enables agents to access customer context and case information within their existing tools, streamlining issue resolution workflows. The SDK is available in all AWS Regions where Amazon Connect Customer operates, eliminating the need for developers to build these capabilities from scratch.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of P6-B200 instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances in the US East (N. Virginia) region for SageMaker Studio notebooks. These instances are powered by 8 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with 1440 GB of GPU memory and 5th Generation Intel Xeon processors, delivering up to 2x better performance than P5en instances for AI training. Customers can use these high-performance instances to develop and fine-tune large foundation models interactively.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of G6e instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 G6e instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks in six additional regions: Middle East (Dubai), Asia Pacific (Tokyo, Seoul), and Europe (Frankfurt, Stockholm, Spain). These instances feature up to 8 NVIDIA L40s Tensor Core GPUs with 48 GB memory per GPU and third-generation AMD EPYC processors, delivering up to 2.5x better performance than G5 instances. The G6e instances enable customers to interactively test model deployments with enhanced GPU capabilities.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of G6 instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 G6 instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks in the Middle East (Dubai) and Asia Pacific (Malaysia) regions. These instances are powered by up to 8 NVIDIA L4 Tensor Core GPUs with 24 GB memory per GPU and third-generation AMD EPYC processors, delivering 2x better deep learning inference performance compared to G4dn instances. Customers can use G6 instances for interactive model deployment testing and development work.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of P4de instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded the availability of Amazon EC2 P4de instances to Asia Pacific (Tokyo, Singapore) and Europe (Frankfurt) regions on SageMaker Studio notebooks. These instances feature 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 80GB memory each (640GB total), offering double the GPU memory of P4d instances. P4de instances deliver up to 60% better ML training performance and 20% lower training costs compared to the previous P4d generation.

announcements.title: ENA Express for Amazon EC2 instances now supports traffic between Availability Zones
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded ENA Express support to enable traffic between EC2 instances across different Availability Zones within a region, delivering up to 25 Gbps single-flow bandwidth. ENA Express uses AWS's Scalable Reliable Datagram (SRD) protocol to improve network performance through advanced congestion control and multi-pathing. This enhancement extends the high-performance networking capabilities beyond instances within the same Availability Zone to cross-AZ communications.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now available in five additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL, AWS's fastest serverless distributed SQL database, has expanded availability to five new regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Mumbai, Singapore), Europe (Stockholm), and South America (Sao Paulo). Aurora DSQL provides unlimited scalability, high availability, and zero infrastructure management for building always-available applications.

announcements.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports caching of cancelled workflow runs
announcements.summary: AWS HealthOmics now supports caching of completed task outputs from cancelled workflow runs, allowing customers to restart from the point of cancellation without recomputing previously finished tasks. When caching is enabled, completed outputs are automatically stored in the customer's S3 bucket for reuse. This feature helps healthcare and life sciences customers avoid redundant computation and accelerate their scientific workflows.

announcements.title: AWS WAF introduces dynamic label interpolation for custom request and response handling
announcements.summary: AWS WAF now supports dynamic label interpolation, allowing security engineers to use a single rule with ${namespace:} syntax to forward entire label namespaces to origins and embed context in responses. This eliminates the need to maintain separate rules for every signal value, significantly simplifying WAF configuration. For example, one rule with a dynamic variable can now forward all IP reputation signals to an application instead of requiring multiple individual rules.

announcements.title: Claude Platform on AWS is now generally available
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Claude Platform on AWS, making AWS the first cloud provider to offer direct access to Anthropic's native Claude Platform experience through existing AWS accounts. This new service provides developers and organizations with access to Claude's APIs, console, and early-access beta features directly within their AWS environment.

announcements.title: AWS Transform adds containerization capability during migrations
announcements.summary: AWS Transform has added containerization capabilities that allow organizations to replatform applications to containers during migration to AWS. The service uses agentic AI to automate the containerization of source code from various repositories (GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab) or zip files, enabling simultaneous migration and modernization. This new feature reduces the time and complexity of transitioning from on-premises infrastructure to cloud-native architectures by combining migration and containerization into a single automated process.

announcements.title: AWS Client VPN now supports Ubuntu OS version 26.04 LTS
announcements.summary: AWS Client VPN now supports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, expanding its Linux desktop client compatibility to include the latest Ubuntu version. The free desktop client allows secure connections for remote workforces to AWS or on-premises networks. AWS Client VPN already supports macOS, Windows, and other Ubuntu-Linux versions.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect adds default Step-by-Step Guides for After Contact Work
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now automatically launches Step-by-Step Guides when agents enter After Contact Work (ACW) state, eliminating the need for manual activation. This feature helps contact centers standardize post-contact workflows and reduce handle time by automatically guiding agents through required wrap-up tasks like logging disposition codes and updating cases.

announcements.title: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver now lets you add and remove AWS Regions for anycast DNS resolution
announcements.summary: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver now allows users to dynamically add and remove AWS Regions for anycast DNS resolution, providing flexible control over DNS query locations. This enhancement enables organizations to easily scale their DNS coverage as they grow and adjust regional deployments to meet compliance requirements. The feature maintains Global Resolver's core capabilities of anycast DNS resolution for both public and private domains, along with DNS filtering and centralized logging.

announcements.title: AWS Service Catalog is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) and Canada West (Calgary) regions
announcements.summary: AWS Service Catalog is now available in two new regions: Asia Pacific (New Zealand) and Canada West (Calgary). This service allows customers to create and manage catalogs of approved Infrastructure as Code (IaC) products that can be deployed on AWS using tools like CloudFormation or Terraform.

announcements.title: IAM Policy Autopilot adds Java support and Terraform-aware policy generation
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded its open-source IAM Policy Autopilot tool to support Java applications and Terraform-aware policy generation, adding to its existing language coverage. The tool, launched at re:Invent 2025, automatically generates baseline IAM policies from code to help developers create less permissive policies and reduce time spent on policy creation and access troubleshooting.

announcements.title: Amazon Route 53 Resolver endpoints now support additional capabilities for IPv6 query traffic
announcements.summary: Amazon Route 53 Resolver endpoints now support DNS64 on inbound endpoints and IPv6 forwarding through internet gateways on outbound endpoints, simplifying hybrid DNS management across IPv4 and IPv6 networks. The DNS64 feature allows IPv6-only on-premises clients to access IPv4 AWS services by automatically synthesizing IPv6 responses for IPv4-only domains. These enhancements make it easier to integrate mixed IPv4/IPv6 environments without requiring changes to existing services.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace introduces Tax management portal for sellers
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched a new Tax management portal that allows sellers to independently view and download invoices through a self-service process, eliminating the need to contact support. The portal is integrated into the AWS Partner Central console and provides centralized access to both seller listing fee invoices and buyer invoices for applicable regions. This streamlines invoice management and record-keeping for marketplace sellers.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G6 instances now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany)
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 G6 instances powered by NVIDIA L4 GPUs in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany). These instances are designed to handle graphics-intensive workloads and machine learning applications including natural language processing, computer vision, speech recognition, and graphics rendering. The availability expands AWS's GPU compute options for customers requiring data sovereignty in the European region.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in Europe (Ireland) and Asia Pacific (Mumbai) regions, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These SAP-certified instances deliver up to 43% higher performance, 1.5x more memory capacity (up to 6TB), and 3.3x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generations, offering the highest performance among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds identity and user management features
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has introduced new administration features that give administrators enhanced control over identity configuration and user management for both IAM and Identity Center domains. In IAM domains, administrators can now onboard users through single sign-on by configuring AWS IAM Identity Center and can add various types of users (IAM roles, users, Identity Center users and groups) as project members. These updates improve team collaboration capabilities within the platform.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G7e instances now available in Europe (London) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 G7e instances powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs are now available in the Europe (London) region. These instances deliver up to 2.3x better inference performance compared to G6e instances and are optimized for deploying large language models, agentic AI, multimodal generative AI, and physical AI models. G7e instances provide the highest performance for spatial computing and hybrid graphics-compute workloads.

announcements.title: AWS Capabilities by Region now supports availability notifications
announcements.summary: AWS has launched availability notifications for AWS Capabilities by Region, a subscription-based system that automatically alerts developers when specific AWS services or features become available in their target regions. This new feature helps builders track the availability of over 1,500 services and features across 37 AWS regions, streamlining infrastructure planning and deployment decisions.

announcements.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor launches Monetization Functions
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental MediaTailor has introduced monetization functions, a new feature that allows customers to customize ad decision server (ADS) requests and manage session data during ad-personalized video playback. This capability enables customers to call external APIs and perform data transformations directly within the playback session, removing the need for middleware between the player and ADS. The feature streamlines ad monetization workflows by providing built-in customization points for common use cases like resolving hashed email addresses.

announcements.title: AWS Advanced JDBC Wrapper now provides client-side encryption
announcements.summary: AWS has added client-side encryption capabilities to its Advanced JDBC Wrapper through a new KMS Encryption plugin, allowing Java applications to encrypt sensitive data at the column level before it reaches Amazon Aurora and RDS databases. This feature works without requiring application code changes and complements the wrapper's existing advanced capabilities like failover handling and AWS authentication integration. The client-side encryption provides an additional security layer beyond the standard database encryption at rest and TLS in transit protections.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports AMI-based node lifecycle configuration for Slurm clusters
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports AMI-based configuration for Slurm clusters, eliminating the need to manually download, configure, or upload lifecycle scripts to S3. This streamlined approach significantly reduces cluster creation time by provisioning nodes with pre-configured software and settings for production-ready AI/ML training environments.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8gn and M8gb instances are now available in AWS Europe (Ireland) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8gn and M8gb instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors are now available in the Europe (Ireland) region, delivering up to 30% better compute performance than Graviton3 processors. The M8gn instances offer up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth (the highest among network-optimized EC2 instances), while M8gb instances provide up to 300 Gbps of EBS bandwidth.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Outbound Campaigns adds multi-contact time zone detection
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Outbound Campaigns has enhanced its time zone detection to analyze all phone numbers and addresses in a customer profile, rather than just the primary contact information. When multiple time zones are detected for a single customer, the system now only makes calls during hours that fall within the configured window for all detected time zones. This improvement helps ensure compliance with calling time restrictions for customers who have contact information spanning multiple geographic regions.

announcements.title: AWS India customers can now use UPI Scan and Pay for sign-up and payments
announcements.summary: AWS now allows customers in India to use UPI (Unified Payments Interface) Scan and Pay for account sign-ups and invoice payments. The new feature enables customers to simply scan a QR code in the AWS Console with popular UPI mobile apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or Amazon Pay for instant bank-to-bank transfers.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 R8idn and R8idb instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 R8idn and R8idb instances powered by custom sixth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and AWS Nitro cards. These new instances deliver up to 43% better compute performance per vCPU compared to previous R6in generation instances, with R8idn instances offering up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth.

announcements.title: AWS Site-to-Site VPN now supports modifying tunnel bandwidth on existing VPN connections
announcements.summary: AWS Site-to-Site VPN now allows users to modify tunnel bandwidth between standard (up to 1.25 Gbps) and large (up to 5 Gbps) on existing connections without recreating them. Previously, bandwidth changes required deleting and recreating the entire connection, which generated new IP addresses and required updates to on-premises configurations. This enhancement simplifies bandwidth scaling while preserving existing tunnel configurations.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region, featuring 8x NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs with 2.1 TB of GPU memory and high-performance networking capabilities.
