announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch RUM (Real User Monitoring) is now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud, allowing developers to collect and analyze real-time client-side performance data from web and mobile applications. This expansion enables customers with strict European data residency and sovereignty requirements to monitor their web application performance while ensuring their data remains within the sovereign boundary.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports cross-region telemetry auditing and enablement rules
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch now supports cross-region telemetry auditing and enablement rules, allowing customers to audit telemetry configuration and enable telemetry from AWS services like EC2, VPC, and CloudTrail across multiple regions from a single location. Customers can enable this auditing feature for their entire account or organization across all supported regions simultaneously and create automated enablement rules that apply to selected or all available regions.

announcements.title: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud
announcements.summary: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, allowing organizations with strict data sovereignty requirements to implement disaster recovery for their critical workloads. The service provides fast, reliable recovery of both on-premises and cloud-based applications with minimal downtime and data loss, offering RPOs in seconds and RTOs in minutes through cost-effective storage and compute resources.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Amazon WorkSpaces Core are now available in two additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon has expanded the availability of WorkSpaces Personal and WorkSpaces Core to US East (Ohio) and Asia Pacific (Malaysia) AWS Regions. This expansion allows organizations to provision virtual desktops closer to their users, providing better performance, in-country data residency, and compliance with local regulations. The Ohio region additionally enables disaster recovery solutions and supports regional workforces with low-latency access to virtual desktop environments.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx for Lustre Persistent-2 file systems are now available in four additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx for Lustre Persistent-2 file systems are now available in four additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hyderabad, Jakarta), Europe (Zurich), and South America (São Paulo). These file systems are built on AWS Graviton processors and offer higher throughput per terabyte (up to 1 GB/s per TB) at lower costs compared to previous generation FSx for Lustre systems.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 X8aedz instances are now available in Europe (Stockholm) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 X8aedz instances are now available in the Europe (Stockholm) region, powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors that deliver the highest maximum CPU frequency of 5GHz in the cloud. These instances are built with sixth generation AWS Nitro Cards and are optimized for electronic design automation (EDA) workloads including physical layout, physical verification, and relational database tasks.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 C8in and C8ib instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 C8in and C8ib instances powered by custom sixth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and the latest AWS Nitro cards. These instances deliver up to 43% better performance than previous C6in instances and scale up to 384 vCPUs, with C8in instances offering 600 Gbps network bandwidth—the highest among enhanced networking instances.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick now supports multi-account sign-in within the same browser
announcements.summary: AWS has announced multi-session support for Amazon QuickSight, allowing users to access up to five accounts simultaneously within the same browser. The feature includes account names in URLs for easier navigation between different assets like dashboards and reports. This enhancement helps customers who use multiple accounts for different environments such as development, testing, and production to more efficiently manage and compare insights across accounts.

announcements.title: Claude Opus 4.7 is now available in Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now offers Claude Opus 4.7, Anthropic's most advanced Opus model, which provides significant improvements in agentic coding, professional work, and long-running tasks for production AI applications. This upgrade from Claude Opus 4.6 delivers stronger performance across production workflows and better handles ambiguous situations for developers and enterprises building AI solutions.

announcements.title: AWS Payment Cryptography now available in South America (São Paulo)
announcements.summary: AWS Payment Cryptography is now available in the South America (São Paulo) region, expanding the service's global reach. This expansion allows customers with latency-sensitive payment applications to deploy locally without relying on cross-region support. AWS Payment Cryptography is a fully managed service that handles payment-specific cryptographic operations and key management for cloud-hosted payment applications.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick Introduces Sheet Tooltips for Rich, Contextual Data Exploration
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight now supports sheet tooltips, allowing report authors to create rich, interactive tooltips that display when users hover over data points. These tooltips can contain custom visuals, text, and images in a flexible layout, and automatically inherit filters from the source visual while adding specific filters for the hovered data point. This feature enhances data exploration by providing contextual details without interrupting the user's analysis workflow.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) Region, featuring 8x NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs with 2.1 TB of GPU memory and high-performance networking capabilities. These instances offer significant improvements over P6-B200 instances, including 2x networking bandwidth, 1.5x GPU memory, and 1.5x GPU TFLOPS, making them optimized for training workloads.

announcements.title: AWS Transform is now available in Kiro and VS Code
announcements.summary: AWS Transform, an AI-powered migration and modernization tool that accelerates enterprise transformations from years to months, is now available in Kiro and VS Code developer environments. The service automates large-scale infrastructure migrations and tech debt reduction while eliminating manual handoffs that typically slow down transformation programs.

announcements.title: AWS Secrets Manager now supports hybrid post-quantum TLS to protect secrets from quantum threats
announcements.summary: AWS Secrets Manager now supports hybrid post-quantum TLS using ML-KEM (Module-Lattice-based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism) to protect secrets from potential quantum computing threats. This quantum-resistant encryption is automatically enabled in Secrets Manager Agent, AWS Lambda Extension, and CSI Driver (all version 2.0.0+), and is also available through supported AWS SDKs. The enhancement provides an additional layer of security for retrieving and managing secrets without requiring any configuration changes from users.

announcements.title: AWS announces general availability of AWS Interconnect - multicloud
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of AWS Interconnect - multicloud, which enables simple, resilient, high-speed private connections between AWS and other cloud service providers. Google Cloud is the first launch partner, with Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure planned to join in 2026. This service addresses the growing customer demand for multicloud strategies by providing secure connectivity options across different cloud platforms.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8gn, M8gn, and R8gn instances now support higher Amazon EBS-optimized performance
announcements.summary: AWS has doubled the Amazon EBS performance for its largest EC2 C8gn, M8gn, and R8gn instances (48xlarge and metal-48xl sizes), increasing from 60 Gbps bandwidth and 240,000 IOPS to 120 Gbps and 480,000 IOPS respectively. These network-optimized instances are powered by AWS Graviton4 processors and 6th generation AWS Nitro Cards, with the performance improvements enabled by enhancements to the AWS Nitro System.

announcements.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super-120B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Qwen3.5-27B models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: AWS has added three new foundation models to Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Super-120B and two Qwen models (3.5-9B and 3.5-27B). These models offer specialized capabilities including agentic reasoning, multilingual coding, and advanced instruction following, allowing AWS customers to deploy high-performance AI solutions for various enterprise challenges.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports Derived Source for storage optimization
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports Derived Source, a new feature that helps reduce storage requirements by eliminating the need to store original source documents separately. Instead of maintaining duplicate copies, the system dynamically reconstructs the _source field on-demand using values already stored in the index. This optimization can significantly decrease storage costs while maintaining full functionality for OpenSearch Service collections.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift introduces key  performance  optimization for Top-K queries
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has introduced a new performance optimization for Top-K queries (those using ORDER BY and LIMIT clauses) that intelligently skips irrelevant data blocks and dramatically reduces the amount of data that needs to be processed. The optimization works by reordering data blocks based on the ORDER BY column's min/max values and keeping only the K most relevant rows in memory. This enhancement provides the greatest performance benefits when the ORDER BY column is sorted or partially sorted.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick now supports document-level access controls for Google Drive knowledge bases
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight now supports document-level access controls (ACLs) for Google Drive knowledge bases, allowing organizations to preserve their existing Google Drive permissions when indexing content. The system uses a dual approach that combines efficient pre-retrieval filtering through ACL replication with real-time permission verification against Google Drive during queries. This ensures both high performance and accurate security by preventing access through stale or incorrectly mapped permissions.

announcements.title: Aurora DSQL launches connector that simplifies building PHP applications
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the Aurora DSQL Connector for PHP (PDO_PGSQL) to simplify building PHP applications on Aurora DSQL. The connector enhances security by automatically generating authentication tokens for each connection, eliminating the need for traditional user-generated passwords while maintaining full compatibility with existing PDO_PGSQL features.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances offer up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, along with up to 20% better performance overall.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region
announcements.summary: AWS has launched EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, offering the highest performance and fastest memory bandwidth among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights now supports saved queries with parameters
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights now supports parameterized saved queries, allowing you to create reusable query templates with placeholders for values like log levels, service names, or time intervals. This feature supports up to 20 parameters per query with optional default values, eliminating the need to maintain multiple copies of similar queries that only differ in specific values.

announcements.title: AWS IoT is now available in Israel (Tel Aviv) and Europe (Milan) AWS Regions
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded its IoT Core and IoT Device Management services to two new regions: Israel (Tel Aviv) and Europe (Milan). This expansion allows organizations in these regions to benefit from faster response times, improved data residency controls, and lower data transfer costs when connecting and managing their IoT devices through AWS's managed cloud platform.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx now supports copying file system backups across AWS opt-in Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx now supports copying file system backups across AWS opt-in Regions (regions that are disabled by default) for Windows File Server, Lustre, and OpenZFS file systems. This enhancement extends cross-region and cross-account backup capabilities beyond default AWS regions, helping customers better meet their business continuity, disaster recovery, and compliance requirements.

announcements.title: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery now supports IPv6
announcements.summary: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) now supports IPv6 for data replication and control plane connections, allowing customers in IPv6-only or dual-stack environments to set up disaster recovery without requiring IPv4 addresses. This enhancement enables organizations to maintain their preferred network configurations while still benefiting from AWS DRS's fast, reliable recovery capabilities with minimal downtime and data loss.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in Europe (Paris)
announcements.summary: Amazon Web Services has launched EC2 X8i instances in Europe (Paris), which are next-generation memory optimized instances powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These SAP-certified instances deliver up to 43% higher performance, 1.5x more memory capacity (up to 6TB), and 3.3x more memory bandwidth compared to the previous generation X2i instances.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines now supports drop and conditional processing
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines now supports conditional processing and a new drop events processor, allowing users to selectively transform and filter log data rather than applying processors uniformly to all entries. This enhancement provides more granular control over log data transformation by enabling rules that determine when processors run and which specific log entries they affect. The feature is part of CloudWatch's fully managed service for ingesting, transforming, and routing log data without infrastructure management overhead.

announcements.title: AWS Deadline Cloud supports monitor creation in multiple regions
announcements.summary: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports creating monitors across multiple AWS Regions without requiring additional IAM Identity Center configuration. This enhancement allows creative teams to deploy render farms with monitors in multiple regions while operating more efficiently by strategically placing rendering resources. The fully managed service helps teams manage and scale their cloud-based rendering workloads more effectively across different geographic locations.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines introduces new compliance and governance capabilities
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines has introduced new compliance and governance features designed to help organizations maintain data integrity and control access during log processing. These capabilities address the needs of organizations with audit or regulatory requirements by providing ways to preserve original data and track modifications made during log transformations. CloudWatch pipelines remains a fully managed service that handles log ingestion, transformation, and routing without requiring infrastructure management.

announcements.title: Second-generation Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP is now available in four additional AWS commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded the availability of second-generation Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file systems to four additional regions: Europe (London), Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), South America (Sao Paulo), and AWS GovCloud (US-West). The second-generation FSx for ONTAP offers improved performance scalability and flexibility compared to first-generation systems, making it easier and more cost-effective to run high-performance file systems in the cloud.

announcements.title: AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards Now Supports Scheduled Email Delivery
announcements.summary: AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards now offers automated email delivery of financial reports on daily, weekly, or monthly schedules. This feature eliminates the need for manual report compilation and allows decision-makers to receive financial insights via secure, password-protected PDF links without requiring direct console access. The scheduled delivery system ensures consistent distribution of cost management reports to relevant stakeholders.

announcements.title: AWS RTB Fabric supports health checks for real-time bidding workloads
announcements.summary: AWS RTB Fabric now includes health checks for real-time bidding workloads using EC2 Auto Scaling groups, which continuously monitor instances and automatically route traffic only to healthy ones. This feature helps eliminate failed bidding transactions caused by bootstrapping, draining, or failed instances, enabling AdTech companies to improve uptime and reduce error rates.

announcements.title: AWS Backup extends Amazon FSx support to 5 additional AWS Regions and expands cross-Region and cross-account copy to 14 AWS Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Backup has expanded support for Amazon FSx file systems (Windows File Server, OpenZFS, and Lustre) to 5 additional AWS Regions including Asia Pacific locations, Canada West, and Mexico Central. The service also now offers cross-Region and cross-account copy capabilities across 14 AWS Regions, allowing customers to centrally manage backup policies, automate schedules, and monitor backup activities in these new locations.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS now supports the latest CU and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) and General Distribution Release (GDR) updates for Microsoft SQL Server versions 2016, 2017, 2019, and 2022. These updates include critical security patches and bug fixes to keep SQL Server databases running securely and efficiently on AWS.

announcements.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB Now Supports Customer-Defined Maintenance Windows
announcements.summary: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now allows customers to define their own maintenance windows, giving them control over when routine database maintenance occurs. Users can specify a weekly maintenance window using day-and-time format in their preferred timezone with IANA timezone identifiers. This feature is available for both InfluxDB 2 instances and InfluxDB 3 clusters across all supported editions.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports cost allocation by IAM user and role
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports cost allocation tracking by IAM users and roles through AWS Cost and Usage Report 2.0 and Cost Explorer. This feature allows customers to attribute Bedrock model inference costs across different users, teams, projects, and applications by tagging IAM principals and analyzing costs through those tags.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service supports Managed Prometheus and agent tracing
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now offers a unified observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and AI agent tracing in one interface. The service includes native integration with Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and comprehensive agent tracing capabilities. This release aims to reduce costs from expensive observability platforms while simplifying operations by consolidating previously fragmented monitoring tools.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Lifecycle pauses actions on objects that are unable to replicate
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Lifecycle now automatically pauses expiration and transition actions on objects that have failed to replicate due to configuration or permission issues. This enhancement helps prevent data loss by ensuring lifecycle rules don't act on objects until replication problems are resolved and the objects can be properly replicated to their destination.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments now supports Amazon RDS Proxy
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments now integrates with Amazon RDS Proxy to enable faster application recovery during database switchovers by eliminating DNS propagation delays. This feature allows developers to create a fully managed staging environment (Green) for testing production changes while keeping the current production database (Blue) safe. Applications can immediately access the new production environment after switchover without requiring any configuration changes.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace announces the Discovery API for programmatic access to catalog data
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched the Discovery API, providing programmatic access to product and pricing information across their entire catalog, including SaaS, AI tools, AMIs, containers, and ML models. The API enables buyers to integrate marketplace data into internal systems and procurement tools, while allowing sellers and channel partners to surface their product listings and pricing information programmatically.

announcements.title: AWS Agent Registry for centralized agent discovery and governance is now available in Preview
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the AWS Agent Registry in preview, a centralized catalog accessible through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that allows organizations to discover and govern AI agents, tools, skills, and other resources within their organization. The registry provides complete visibility into an organization's AI landscape, helping teams avoid rebuilding existing capabilities by enabling them to find and reuse existing agents and tools. Users can access the registry through the AgentCore Console UI, APIs (AWS CLI, AWS SDK), or as an MCP server.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports Zstandard (zstd) codec for index compression
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports Zstandard (zstd) codec for index compression, allowing customers to reduce index size by up to 32% compared to the default LZ4 codec. This feature helps lower managed storage costs for data-intensive workloads while giving customers more control over the balance between storage expenses and query performance. The enhancement particularly benefits customers running large-scale log analytics, observability pipelines, and time-series workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager now supports tag-based dimensions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager now supports tag-based dimensions, allowing users to group and filter capacity metrics using up to five custom tag keys from their EC2 resources (such as environment, team, or cost-center). The service helps monitor and optimize capacity usage across On-Demand Instances, Spot Instances, and Capacity Reservations. This update also introduces Account Name as a new built-in dimension for better resource organization.

announcements.title: SageMaker HyperPod now supports gang scheduling for distributed training workloads
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports gang scheduling, which ensures all required pods for distributed training jobs are ready before training begins. This feature prevents wasted compute resources from partial job runs and helps administrators avoid deadlocks when jobs are waiting for resources. The capability is particularly beneficial for data scientists running distributed AI/ML training workloads that require multiple pods to work together across nodes.

announcements.title: Amazon IVS Real-Time Streaming now supports redundant ingest
announcements.summary: Amazon IVS Real-Time Streaming has introduced redundant ingest functionality, allowing users to stream from two encoders simultaneously to a single stage with automatic failover protection. This feature helps prevent stream interruptions caused by encoder failures or network issues, ensuring continuous delivery to viewers. The capability is particularly valuable for critical live events, 24/7 streaming, or any scenario requiring uninterrupted broadcast reliability.

announcements.title: Amazon EKS managed node groups now support EC2 Auto Scaling warm pools
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS managed node groups now support EC2 Auto Scaling warm pools, which maintain pre-initialized instances ready for immediate deployment. This feature significantly reduces node provisioning latency, making it ideal for applications with burst traffic patterns, time-sensitive workloads, or complex initialization requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser adds OS-level interaction capabilities
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser has added OS-level interaction capabilities that enable automation beyond the standard Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). This enhancement allows the system to handle tasks requiring direct operating system control, such as mouse operations, print dialogs, native system alerts, and keyboard shortcuts. The feature is designed for AI agent developers, test automation engineers, and organizations building LLM-powered web interactions.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Advisor now available for AI-powered troubleshooting
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Advisor is a new AI-powered troubleshooting tool that helps administrators quickly identify and resolve issues with Amazon WorkSpaces Personal by analyzing configurations and providing actionable recommendations. The tool uses generative AI capabilities to streamline administrative workflows and reduce the time needed to investigate and fix common WorkSpace problems. This enables faster service restoration and performance optimization for virtual desktop environments.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports Graviton4 based i8ge instances
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports i8ge instances, the latest generation of storage-optimized instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors. These instances deliver up to 60% better compute performance compared to previous generation Graviton2-based Im4gn instances and up to 55% better real-time storage performance using third-generation AWS Nitro SSDs. The i8ge instances are designed to provide optimal performance for storage-intensive workloads.

announcements.title: Oracle Database@AWS is now available in twelve AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Oracle Database@AWS has expanded to five additional regions (Dublin, London, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Seoul), bringing the total to twelve AWS regions. This service provides Oracle Cloud Infrastructure managed Oracle Exadata systems directly within AWS data centers. The expansion particularly benefits customers in Europe and Asia Pacific who have data residency requirements and need to migrate from on-premises Oracle systems.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda expands response streaming support to all commercial AWS Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda response streaming is now available in all commercial AWS Regions, achieving full regional parity for this capability. This feature allows Lambda functions to send partial responses to clients incrementally using the InvokeWithResponseStream API, rather than waiting to buffer the complete response. Response streaming reduces time-to-first-byte (TTFB) latency by enabling progressive payload delivery as data becomes available.

announcements.title: Amazon Lightsail is now available in the Asia Pacific (Malaysia) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon Lightsail is now available in the Asia Pacific (Malaysia) Region, expanding the service's reach to Malaysian customers and surrounding areas. This new regional availability offers customers lower latency, improved performance, and the ability to meet local data residency requirements. The Malaysia region provides access to Lightsail's complete feature set, including various compute instances to meet different application needs.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock now offers Claude Mythos Preview (Gated Research Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now provides access to Claude Mythos Preview, Anthropic's most advanced AI model, through a gated research preview as part of Project Glasswing. This new model class offers state-of-the-art capabilities in cybersecurity, software coding, and complex reasoning, with particular strength in identifying sophisticated security vulnerabilities in software.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker adds serverless workflows to Identity Center domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has expanded Serverless Workflows support to Identity Center domains, allowing customers to orchestrate data processing tasks using Apache Airflow without managing infrastructure. This feature automatically provisions and releases compute resources as workflows run, and was previously only available in IAM-based domains. The enhancement enables organizations using Identity Center domains to leverage serverless Apache Airflow orchestration through Amazon's Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow service.

announcements.title: Announcing Amazon S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Files is a new feature that makes S3 buckets accessible as traditional file systems, allowing AWS compute resources to interact with S3 data using standard file system operations. This breakthrough makes Amazon S3 the first cloud object store to provide full file system semantics with high performance and low latency. The feature enables file-based applications and teams to work with S3 data using familiar file system tools without the data leaving the S3 environment.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances. The instances are currently available for Amazon RDS for Oracle under the Bring Your Own License model.

announcements.title: Amazon Braket adds support for Rigetti's 108-qubit Cepheus QPU
announcements.summary: Amazon Braket now provides access to Rigetti's Cepheus-1-108Q, marking the first 100+ qubit superconducting quantum processing unit available on AWS's quantum computing service. The device features a modular multi-chip architecture with twelve 9-qubit chiplets arranged in a 3x4 array, connected by tunable and intermodule couplers, and introduces CZ (controlled phase) gates instead of the previously used iSWAP gates.

announcements.title: AWS Transfer Family now supports IPv6 for connectors and web apps
announcements.summary: AWS Transfer Family has added IPv6 support for SFTP connectors, AS2 connectors, and web applications. This enhancement allows connectors to communicate with remote servers and trading partners over IPv6 networks, while also enabling end users to access Transfer Family web apps using IPv6 connections.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora now supports PostgreSQL 17.9, 16.13, 15.17, and 14.22
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition now supports updated versions 17.9, 16.13, 15.17, and 14.22, which include community bug fixes and Aurora-specific enhancements. AWS recommends upgrading to these latest minor versions to address security vulnerabilities and benefit from performance improvements, with upgrades available during scheduled maintenance windows using automatic minor version upgrades.

announcements.title: AWS Certificate Manager now supports native certificate search
announcements.summary: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) has introduced a native certificate search feature that allows users to find certificates using parameters like domain name, certificate ARN, and validity status through both a console search bar and a new SearchCertificates API. This enhancement is particularly useful for administrators managing multiple certificates who need to quickly locate specific certificates or identify those nearing expiration.

announcements.title: AWS Cost Explorer launches Natural Language Query capabilities powered by Amazon Q
announcements.summary: AWS Cost Explorer has integrated Amazon Q Developer's generative AI to enable natural language queries for analyzing AWS cost and usage data. Users can now ask questions in plain English and receive both answers and automatically updated visualizations, making cost analysis faster and more accessible to all team members. This feature reduces the time needed to gain cost insights and eliminates the need for complex query syntax.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds notebook import/export and developer acceleration features
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has added notebook import/export capabilities that support .ipynb, .json, and .py formats, enabling easy migration from JupyterLab and other platforms. The release also introduces developer productivity features like cell reordering, keyboard shortcuts, cell renaming, and multi-line SQL support to streamline workflows for data engineers and scientists.

announcements.title: Amazon Verified Permissions now supports policy store aliases and named policies and policy templates
announcements.summary: Amazon Verified Permissions has added support for policy store aliases and named policies/templates to simplify multi-tenant deployments and policy management. These new features eliminate the need for separate mapping tables that associate tenant identifiers with policy store IDs. The enhancements streamline day-to-day operations for the fine-grained authorization service that uses Cedar policies to manage application permissions.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal now supports unique DNS names for PrivateLink
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal now assigns unique, publicly resolvable DNS names to each AWS PrivateLink VPC endpoint, replacing the previous shared generic DNS names. This enhancement allows enterprise customers to deploy WorkSpaces across multiple AWS VPCs and accounts without experiencing DNS resolution conflicts.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Region, allowing customers to create fully managed shared file storage systems built on OpenZFS. This service provides a cost-effective, high-performance file system solution in the cloud with enhanced reliability, security, and scalability features.

announcements.title: AWS announces general availability of Smithy-Java client framework
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Smithy-Java, an open-source Java framework that generates type-safe clients and standalone classes from Smithy models. The framework addresses enterprise users' need for production-grade Java SDK generation and helps reduce cognitive load and maintenance burden for developers building modern Java applications.

announcements.title: AWS IoT Greengrass component SDK for C, C++, and Rust applications
announcements.summary: AWS has launched a new Greengrass component SDK designed for C, C++, and Rust applications running on AWS IoT Greengrass. The SDK enables deployment of sophisticated AI and ML workloads on resource-constrained edge devices, targeting industries like automotive, industrial IoT, robotics, and smart buildings. It maintains full compatibility with both AWS IoT Greengrass nucleus and nucleus lite capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 starts rolling out new security best practice to new and existing buckets by default
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 is implementing a new security default that automatically disables server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) for all new general purpose buckets. For existing buckets without SSE-C encrypted objects, S3 will also block new SSE-C write requests, while accounts currently using SSE-C will see no changes to their existing bucket configurations. This change rolled out starting November 19, 2025, as part of AWS's enhanced security best practices.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports Oracle Management Agent version 24.1.0.0.v1 for Oracle Enterprise Manager Cloud Control 24aiR1
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports Oracle Management Agent (OMA) version 24.1.0.0.v1, enabling compatibility with Oracle Enterprise Manager Cloud Control 24ai Release 1. This update allows customers running OMS version 24.1 Release 1 or later to monitor and manage their RDS Oracle databases through OEM's web-based management tools.

announcements.title: Apache Spark troubleshooting and upgrade agents now available as Kiro powers
announcements.summary: AWS has released Apache Spark troubleshooting and upgrade agents as Kiro powers, providing one-click AI-assisted Spark operations within the Kiro platform. These tools help data engineers dramatically reduce troubleshooting time from hours to minutes and accelerate Spark version upgrades from months to weeks by automatically analyzing logs, metrics, and configurations across EMR environments.

announcements.title: AWS Glue Schema Registry is now available in three more AWS regions
announcements.summary: AWS Glue Schema Registry, a serverless and free feature, is now available in three additional regions: Asia Pacific (Jakarta), Europe (Spain), and Europe (Zurich). This service provides centralized management and validation of streaming data schemas in Apache Avro, JSON, and Protobuf formats, helping eliminate data validation complexity between decoupled applications in data streaming systems.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent introduces charting capabilities and support for materialized views
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent has expanded its capabilities to include interactive charting, SQL analytics on Snowflake data sources, and materialized view management within SageMaker Unified Studio notebooks. The enhanced service now offers a complete analytics workflow that allows users to explore data sources, visualize results, and optimize query performance using natural language prompts. Users can simply ask questions like "plot monthly revenue trends by region for 2025" and Data Agent will automatically generate the appropriate visualizations and analysis.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails announces general availability of cross-account safeguards
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails has launched cross-account safeguards in general availability, allowing organizations to centrally enforce safety controls across all AWS accounts from a single location. The feature helps block up to 88% of harmful multimodal content in both input prompts and model responses, while also filtering hallucinated outputs from foundation models. This enables central security teams to automatically implement consistent safety controls across all foundation model interactions throughout their organization.

announcements.title: Partner Revenue Measurement now supports User Agent string for certain AWS services
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Partner Revenue Measurement User Agent string, a new feature that allows AWS Partners to track AWS service consumption generated by their solutions through APIs and SDKs. Partners can embed a unique product code from their AWS Marketplace listing as a user agent to measure their revenue impact and understand product consumption patterns. This capability helps Partners better quantify how their solutions drive AWS service usage and revenue.

announcements.title: Partner Revenue Measurement now supports AWS Marketplace Metering for certain AWS Marketplace products
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Partner Revenue Measurement integration with AWS Marketplace Metering for Amazon Machine Image (AMI) and Machine Learning (ML) products. This integration allows partners to better understand their AWS revenue impact and product consumption patterns by automatically measuring AWS service consumption when customers purchase and use these marketplace products. The feature helps partners gain clearer visibility into how their marketplace offerings drive AWS service usage and revenue.

announcements.title: AWS Secrets Manager console now supports custom input for AWS KMS keys
announcements.summary: AWS Secrets Manager console now supports custom input for AWS KMS keys when creating secrets, allowing users to directly enter a KMS key Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in addition to selecting from the existing dropdown list. This enhancement provides more flexibility beyond the previous limitation of only choosing from pre-populated KMS keys within the same AWS account.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch introduces PromQL querying with Query Studio Preview
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch has launched Query Studio in public preview, which introduces native PromQL querying capabilities to CloudWatch for the first time. The unified interface allows users to query both AWS metrics and OpenTelemetry metrics using either PromQL or CloudWatch Metric Insights without switching between consoles. Query Studio includes helpful features like a visual form builder with autocomplete and a code editor with syntax highlighting.

announcements.title: Amazon ElastiCache Serverless now supports IPv6 and dual stack connectivity
announcements.summary: Amazon ElastiCache Serverless has expanded its connectivity options to support IPv6 and dual stack configurations, in addition to the previously available IPv4-only connectivity. Users can now choose between IPv4, IPv6, or dual stack network types when creating a Serverless cache. The dual stack option allows caches to accept connections over both IPv4 and IPv6 simultaneously, providing greater flexibility for application connectivity and migration scenarios.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch launches OTel Container Insights for Amazon EKS (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch has launched a public preview of OTel Container Insights for Amazon EKS, which enhances the existing Container Insights by collecting metrics from open source and AWS collectors using the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). This new capability provides deeper visibility into EKS clusters and automatically enriches each metric with up to 150 descriptive labels, including Kubernetes metadata and custom information.

announcements.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports configurable job scheduling modes for queues
announcements.summary: AWS Deadline Cloud now offers configurable job scheduling modes that give users control over how workers are distributed across jobs in a queue. Previously, all workers were automatically assigned to the highest-priority, earliest-submitted job first, which could cause delays for other jobs waiting in the queue. This update provides more flexibility in managing render workloads for 2D/3D graphics and visual effects production.

announcements.title: Announcing compute-optimized instance bundles for Amazon Lightsail
announcements.summary: Amazon Lightsail has launched new compute-optimized instance bundles offering up to 72 vCPUs in 7 different sizes, with support for both IPv6-only and dual-stack networking. These instances support all existing Lightsail blueprints, including popular applications like WordPress, cPanel & WHM, Plesk, Drupal, and Magento on both Linux and Windows operating systems.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch expands auto-enablement to Amazon CloudFront logs and 3 additional resource types
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch has expanded its auto-enablement feature to support Amazon CloudFront Standard access logs, AWS Security Hub CSPM finding logs, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore memory and gateway logs and traces. Customers can now create enablement rules that automatically configure telemetry for both existing and new resources, eliminating the need for manual setup and ensuring consistent monitoring coverage. These rules can be applied at the organization, account, or specific resource level for flexible deployment.

announcements.title: AWS Direct Connect announces 100G expansion in Auckland, New Zealand
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded its Direct Connect service in Auckland, New Zealand to offer 100 Gbps dedicated connections at the Datacom Orbit DH6 data center. This location now provides private, direct network access to all public AWS Regions (excluding China), AWS GovCloud Regions, and AWS Local Zones. This marks the second AWS Direct Connect location in New Zealand to offer 100 Gbps connections with MACsec encryption capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports OpenTelemetry metrics in public preview
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch now supports native OpenTelemetry (OTel) metrics in public preview, allowing users to send metrics directly using the OpenTelemetry Protocol without custom conversion logic or additional tooling. Users can combine their custom OpenTelemetry metrics with AWS-provided metrics from over 70 services and query them using PromQL without requiring additional agents or code changes.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications improves multi-session fleet management
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications has introduced a "drain mode" feature for multi-session fleets that allows instances to stop accepting new user sessions while keeping existing sessions running without interruption. This capability enables seamless maintenance, scaling, and system updates without disrupting active users. Multi-session fleets help organizations maximize infrastructure utilization by hosting multiple user sessions on a single instance.

announcements.title: Amazon SES Mail Manager adds new features for enhanced security and email processing
announcements.summary: Amazon SES Mail Manager has introduced new security and processing features, including optional TLS and certificate-based authentication (mTLS) support for Ingress Endpoints, plus two new rule actions: Invoke Lambda function and Bounce. These enhancements help organizations maintain compatibility with legacy systems while implementing stronger security controls and simplifying email infrastructure migrations.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS announces Managed Daemons for ECS Managed Instances
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS has introduced Managed Daemons for ECS Managed Instances, allowing organizations to centrally deploy and manage software agents (security, observability, and networking) across their container infrastructure independently from application deployments. This feature decouples daemon lifecycle management from application operations, ensuring reliable agent coverage across all workloads while simplifying deployments, version updates, and improving resource utilization.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent now supports geo-specific inference for Japan and Australia
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent now supports geo-specific inference for Japan and Australia through Amazon Bedrock cross-region inference profiles. This enhancement ensures that inference requests from the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and Asia Pacific (Sydney) regions are processed within their respective local geographies to meet data sovereignty requirements. The feature helps customers in these regions maintain compliance while using Data Agent's AI-powered conversational capabilities for data exploration and code generation.

announcements.title: AWS VPC Encryption Controls now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: AWS has launched VPC Encryption Controls in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, enabling organizations to easily audit and enforce encryption in transit within and across Virtual Private Clouds. This feature helps demonstrate compliance with encryption standards by monitoring traffic flows and identifying resources that may be allowing unencrypted plaintext traffic. The controls can be applied to existing VPCs and automatically enforce encryption across different network paths.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports SHA-256 for signed URLs and signed cookies
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront now supports SHA-256 as a hash algorithm for creating signed URLs and signed cookies, upgrading from the previous SHA-1-only option. This enhancement provides stronger cryptographic security with better collision detection and alignment with modern security standards. The new SHA-256 support helps customers meet stricter security and compliance requirements when restricting access to content.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports cross-account snapshot sharing with additional storage volumes
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports cross-account snapshot sharing for database instances that use additional storage volumes, which allow customers to scale storage up to 256 TiB total by adding up to three 64 TiB volumes beyond the primary storage. This enhancement enables customers to create, share, and copy database snapshots across different AWS accounts even when their Oracle instances are configured with these additional storage volumes.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs to AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has expanded its structured outputs feature to AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, enabling foundation models to return consistent, schema-compliant responses. This enhancement is specifically designed for government and regulated workloads that require strict compliance and data handling standards. The feature ensures machine-readable outputs that meet the rigorous requirements of federal and regulated environments.

announcements.title: Oracle Database@AWS launches sub-millisecond network latency for high performance applications
announcements.summary: Oracle Database@AWS has launched high performance networking that delivers consistent sub-millisecond roundtrip latency between AWS applications and Oracle databases. This enhancement specifically targets latency-sensitive applications like payment processing, securities trading, and high-volume transaction processing that require predictable, low-latency database connectivity. The service brings the performance benefits that customers previously achieved with on-premises Oracle Exadata systems to the AWS cloud environment.

announcements.title: AWS Managed Microsoft AD adds Multi-Region replication for Opt-In regions
announcements.summary: AWS Managed Microsoft AD now supports Multi-Region replication in AWS Opt-In regions, expanding this capability beyond the standard AWS regions. This eliminates the need to manually create and synchronize separate directories in each region, allowing domain-joined workloads to automatically connect to AWS Managed Microsoft AD across multiple regions.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports ingesting Security Hub CSPM findings with organization-wide enablement
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch now supports ingesting AWS Security Hub Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) findings, allowing customers to centrally analyze and monitor security data directly in CloudWatch Logs. The integration supports both AWS Security Finding Format (ASFF) and Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) formats through CloudWatch Pipelines. This enables customers to use CloudWatch Logs Insights for querying findings and creating metric filters for enhanced security monitoring across their organization.

announcements.title: AWS launches Sustainability console for carbon emissions tracking
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the AWS Sustainability console, a free standalone service that allows customers to track their carbon emissions and environmental impact from AWS usage. This new service expands on the existing Customer Carbon Footprint Tool by removing access barriers, enabling sustainability professionals to view emissions data without needing billing permissions. The console ensures organizations can provide the appropriate teams with access to environmental data for better sustainability management.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service introduces agentic AI for log analytics
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service has launched agentic AI capabilities that allow engineering and support teams to analyze log data through natural language conversations. The new features simplify log querying and speed up incident investigations by enabling autonomous root cause analysis and maintaining persistent conversations within the OpenSearch UI. This enhancement transforms how teams interact with observability data by replacing complex queries with intuitive conversational interfaces.

announcements.title: AWS IAM Identity Center is now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region
announcements.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center is now available in the new AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region, which is designed to help customers meet sovereignty requirements by being entirely located within the EU. IAM Identity Center is AWS's recommended service for managing workforce access to AWS applications, allowing organizations to connect their existing identity sources and provide users with single sign-on access.

announcements.title: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink now supports Apache Flink 2.2
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink now supports Apache Flink version 2.2, which includes significant runtime improvements like Java 17 support, RocksDB 8.10.0 for enhanced I/O performance, and serialization enhancements. The update deprecates Dataset API and Scala APIs, while allowing users to either create new applications on Flink 2.2 or perform in-place version upgrades for existing compatible applications.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds Observability for AWS Glue jobs via CloudWatch metrics
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now provides enhanced observability for AWS Glue jobs by displaying Amazon CloudWatch metrics directly alongside job logs in a single interface. This new feature enables data engineers and ETL developers to streamline troubleshooting by correlating resource utilization patterns like DPU utilization, memory consumption, and CPU load with job performance. The integration allows teams to diagnose performance issues more quickly and efficiently.

announcements.title: AWS Organizations now provides organization paths in API responses
announcements.summary: AWS Organizations now includes complete organizational paths for accounts and organizational units (OUs) directly in API responses, eliminating the need for multiple API calls to navigate organizational hierarchies. This enhancement streamlines management for enterprise customers with complex, deeply nested AWS Organizations by providing full structural context in a single API call.

announcements.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports new fleet scaling configurations for render farms
announcements.summary: AWS Deadline Cloud has introduced three new fleet scaling configurations - worker idle duration, standby worker count, and scale out rate - that provide greater flexibility for managing render farm capacity and performance. These new options allow creative teams to directly control the balance between rendering speed and cost efficiency in their cloud-based rendering workloads. AWS Deadline Cloud is a fully managed service designed to help teams efficiently scale their rendering operations.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace sellers can now self-serve refunds and agreement cancellations
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched a new self-service feature that allows sellers to process refunds and cancel agreements directly without filing support tickets. The streamlined process provides full visibility for both sellers and buyers, with buyers able to review and approve cancellation requests through the AWS Marketplace console and see refunds on their charge summary.

announcements.title: Aurora DSQL launches new connectors that simplify building .NET and Rust applications
announcements.summary: AWS has released new connectors for Aurora DSQL that simplify building applications in .NET (Npgsql) and Rust (SQLx). These connectors automatically handle authentication by generating tokens for each connection, eliminating the need for traditional passwords while maintaining full compatibility with existing Npgsql and SQLx features.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Vectors expands to 17 additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Vectors has expanded its availability to 17 additional AWS Regions across Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe, North America, and South America. This expansion includes regions such as Cape Town, Hong Kong, Hyderabad, Jakarta, Melbourne, Zurich, Mexico Central, and others. The service is described as the first cloud object storage solution for vector data, making it more globally accessible for customers worldwide.

announcements.title: AWS announces End User Messaging Notify
announcements.summary: AWS has launched End User Messaging Notify, a new service that allows developers to send one-time passcodes (OTPs) within minutes using AWS-owned phone numbers and sender IDs. This eliminates the typical weeks or months businesses usually spend obtaining phone numbers, completing carrier registrations, and setting up sender IDs for customer verification systems.

announcements.title: AWS Service Availability Updates
announcements.summary: AWS is announcing that Amazon Application Recovery Controller will be moving to maintenance mode starting April 30, 2026. New customers will no longer be able to access this service after that date, but existing customers can continue using it with ongoing AWS support and operations. AWS recommends that customers review the changes in the product documentation to understand the implications.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports Amazon EC2 instance store
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports Amazon EC2 instance store volumes as a data volume option for container workloads. This enhancement allows users to leverage instance store volumes instead of provisioning Amazon EBS data volumes, resulting in reduced storage costs and improved I/O performance for latency-sensitive applications.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations is now generally available
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations is now generally available, offering automated quality assessment tools for AI agents. The service provides two evaluation types: online evaluation that continuously monitors agent performance in production by sampling live traffic, and on-demand evaluation for testing workflows and validating changes. This enables developers to measure agent performance against defined expectations and maintain quality standards through continuous monitoring.

announcements.title: AWS End User Messaging now supports RCS for Business
announcements.summary: AWS End User Messaging has added support for Rich Communication Services (RCS) for Business, allowing companies to send messages that display their verified business name and logo instead of generic phone numbers. This enhancement helps businesses build greater trust with customers by delivering branded messages through the messaging apps customers already use. The service provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for integrating RCS capabilities into business applications.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports multi-account and region log centralization based on data source
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch now supports centralizing logs from multiple AWS accounts and regions based on data source name and type, rather than just log group names. Customers can create centralization rules that target specific data sources like VPC Flow Logs, EKS Audit Logs, and CloudTrail Logs to copy them into a single destination account. This enhancement provides more flexible and intuitive log management across multi-account AWS environments.

announcements.title: AWS Security Hub is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Security Hub is now available in both AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) Regions. This unified cloud security solution helps organizations prioritize critical security issues and respond at scale by correlating security signals from services like Amazon GuardDuty and Amazon Inspector. The expansion enables government and regulated organizations to improve their security posture and team productivity within the GovCloud environment.

announcements.title: AWS HealthOmics introduces VPC-connected workflows
announcements.summary: AWS HealthOmics has launched VPC-connected workflows, allowing life sciences customers to run bioinformatics pipelines that can access AWS resources across different regions and public internet resources through their Virtual Private Cloud. This eliminates the need for customers to migrate their data and dependencies to the same AWS Region as their workflow before running analyses. The HIPAA-eligible service is designed to help accelerate scientific breakthroughs at scale.

announcements.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now available in Europe (London)
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental MediaTailor, a personalized ad insertion and channel assembly service, is now available in the Europe (London) AWS Region. The service enables video providers to deliver targeted ads in live and on-demand streams using server-side ad insertion, providing broadcast-quality viewing without buffering or ad blocker issues. This expansion helps customers better serve viewers in Europe with improved performance and reduced latency.

announcements.title: Amazon Athena launches Capacity Reservations in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Athena has expanded Capacity Reservations to additional AWS regions including US West (N. California), Africa (Cape Town), and several Asia Pacific locations. Capacity Reservations provide dedicated serverless capacity that allows your most critical workloads to run in isolation with controlled query concurrency, separate from other workloads in your account.

announcements.title: Access Cluster Insights through the Amazon OpenSearch Service Console and Amazon EventBridge events
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now allows users to access Cluster Insights directly through the AWS Management Console, eliminating the need to switch between interfaces when reviewing performance and resilience recommendations. Additionally, Cluster Insights can now publish operational health insights as events to Amazon EventBridge for improved automation and monitoring capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent is now available in the Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio Query Editor
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent is now available in the Query Editor within Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio, expanding beyond its previous notebook-only availability. The feature enables users to generate SQL queries from natural language prompts, debug failed queries, and explore data through a conversational interface. This brings the same AI-powered conversational experience from notebooks to SQL analytics workflows, allowing users to perform complex data analysis tasks using plain English commands.

announcements.title: AWS Direct Connect adds CloudWatch metrics for BGP monitoring
announcements.summary: AWS Direct Connect now offers three new CloudWatch metrics that provide native monitoring of BGP session health and route counts for virtual interfaces (VIFs). This eliminates the need for network engineers to build custom solutions or use Lambda functions to monitor BGP sessions in hybrid cloud environments. The new metrics give operations teams better visibility into their Direct Connect connectivity through AWS's standard monitoring service.

announcements.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB Now Supports Advanced Metrics
announcements.summary: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB has launched Advanced Metrics, which automatically publishes detailed operational metrics from InfluxDB 2 instances directly to Amazon CloudWatch for comprehensive database performance monitoring. This new feature enables real-time monitoring and alerting without requiring additional configuration, supporting both Single-AZ and Multi-AZ deployments.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs now supports data protection,  OpenSearch PPL and OpenSearch SQL for the Infrequent Access ingestion class
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs has expanded its Infrequent Access (Logs IA) ingestion class with new capabilities including data protection features, OpenSearch PPL (Piped Processing Language), and OpenSearch SQL support. These enhancements enable customers to perform flexible analytics and protect sensitive data while cost-effectively consolidating logs natively on AWS. The improvements make Logs IA particularly well-suited for ad-hoc troubleshooting and forensic analysis of infrequently accessed log data.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda supports up to 32 GB of memory and 16 vCPUs for Lambda Managed Instances
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda has expanded its capabilities to support up to 32 GB of memory and 16 vCPUs for Lambda Managed Instances, allowing customers to run compute-intensive workloads like data processing, media transcoding, and scientific simulations without infrastructure management. Users can now configure customizable memory-to-vCPU ratios (2:1, 4:1, or 8:1) to optimize resource allocation for their specific workloads.

announcements.title: AWS Management Console now supports settings to control service and Region visibility
announcements.summary: AWS has launched new account settings for the AWS Management Console that allow administrators to control which services and regions are visible to users within their account. These "Visible services" and "Visible Regions" settings help simplify navigation and make it easier for users to identify what resources are available to them. The settings can be configured through the Unified Settings section in the Account Settings tab of the AWS Management Console.

announcements.title: Amazon GameLift Servers expands instance support with next-generation EC2 instance families
announcements.summary: Amazon GameLift Servers now supports next-generation EC2 instances (5th-8th generation), providing improved price-performance, efficiency, and flexibility for game server hosting. The update includes support for General Purpose (M-series) instances with balanced resources and Compute Optimized (C-series) instances with high-performance compute capabilities for various game workloads.

announcements.title: AWS HealthImaging announces study-level fine-grained access control
announcements.summary: AWS HealthImaging has introduced fine-grained access control that allows organizations to manage access to medical imaging data at the DICOM study and series levels. This new feature enables customers to grant users access to specific image sets through easy-to-maintain IAM policies, improving security and workflow management for medical imaging data stored in AWS HealthImaging.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances now available in Europe (Milan)
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances are now available in the Europe (Milan) region, offering two configurations: U7i-8TB instances with 8TiB of DDR5 memory and U7i-12TB instances with 12TiB of DDR5 memory. These 7th generation instances are powered by custom fourth generation Intel Xeon Scalable Processors (Sapphire Rapids) and are designed to help customers scale transaction processing throughput in fast-growing data environments.

announcements.title: AWS Step Functions adds 28 new service integrations, including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
announcements.summary: AWS Step Functions has added 28 new service integrations and over 1,100 new API actions, including support for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon S3 Vectors. This expansion allows users to orchestrate a broader range of AWS services directly within their workflows without needing to write custom integration code.

announcements.title: Palmyra Vision 7B from Writer now available on Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: AWS has made Palmyra Vision 7B from Writer available on Amazon Bedrock, enabling customers to build generative AI applications that can interpret and generate text from images. This addition allows users to create visual understanding applications through Bedrock's fully managed service without needing to handle inference infrastructure themselves.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Studio launches support for Kiro and Cursor IDEs as remote IDEs
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Studio now supports remote connections from Kiro and Cursor IDEs, enabling developers to use their preferred development environments while accessing SageMaker's scalable compute resources. This integration allows data scientists and ML engineers to leverage Kiro and Cursor's features like spec-driven development and conversational coding within the SageMaker ecosystem. The connection is facilitated through the AWS Toolkit extension.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports FIPS-certified workloads on Graviton and GPU accelerated instances in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports FIPS-compliant deployment of Graviton-based and GPU-accelerated workloads in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. This enhancement allows government and regulated customers to run containerized workloads that meet Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) cryptographic security requirements on these specialized instance types.

announcements.title: Research and Engineering Studio on AWS 2026.03 is now available
announcements.summary: AWS has released Research and Engineering Studio (RES) on AWS version 2026.03, featuring new administrator controls, expanded filesystem support, and improved session management. RES is an open-source web portal that enables administrators to create and manage secure cloud-based research environments for scientists and engineers to visualize data and run interactive applications without requiring cloud expertise.

announcements.title: AWS Parallel Computing Service supports slurmdbd and cgroups settings
announcements.summary: AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) now supports additional Slurm configuration settings for slurmdbd and cgroups, allowing users to fine-tune accounting behavior and resource isolation through AWS management interfaces. This enhancement enables the implementation of production-ready HPC environments with better privacy controls, flexible data retention policies, and improved resource management capabilities.

announcements.title: Aurora DSQL launches connector that simplifies building Ruby applications
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the Aurora DSQL Connector for Ruby that simplifies building Ruby applications on Aurora DSQL while maintaining full compatibility with the existing pg gem. The connector automatically handles IAM token generation and SSL configuration, eliminating security risks from traditional passwords by using auto-generated tokens for each connection.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda increases the file descriptor limit to 4,096 for functions running on Lambda Managed Instances
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda has increased the file descriptor limit from 1,024 to 4,096 for functions running on Lambda Managed Instances (LMI), providing a 4x improvement. This enhancement allows customers to run I/O intensive workloads like high-concurrency web services and file-heavy data processing pipelines without hitting file descriptor constraints. LMI runs Lambda functions on managed EC2 instances with built-in routing, load-balancing, and auto-scaling capabilities.

announcements.title: AWS AppConfig adds enhanced targeting during feature flag rollout
announcements.summary: AWS AppConfig has introduced enhanced targeting controls that allow customers to direct feature flags and configuration changes to specific user segments or individual users during gradual rollouts. This new capability builds on AppConfig's existing safety feature of progressive delivery, which enables slow rollouts over minutes or hours to minimize the impact of unexpected issues. The enhancement provides more granular control over who receives changes during the deployment lifecycle.

announcements.title: The AWS Advanced JDBC Wrapper now supports automatic query caching with Valkey
announcements.summary: The AWS Advanced JDBC Wrapper now supports automatic query caching with Valkey, including Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey. This eliminates the need for developers to manually write caching code for each JDBC query when working with Aurora and RDS databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB). The feature can be enabled by simply adding the wrapper dependency and configuring the query cache plugin.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8gd instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8gd instances, powered by AWS Graviton4 processors, are now available in six additional AWS regions including US West (N. California), several Asia Pacific locations, Africa (Cape Town), and Canada West (Calgary). These instances offer up to 11.4 TB of local NVMe SSD storage and deliver up to 30% better performance than Graviton3-based instances, with particularly strong improvements for I/O intensive database workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8a instances now available in AWS Europe (Ireland) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8a instances are now available in the AWS Europe (Ireland) region, powered by 5th generation AMD EPYC processors with up to 4.5 GHz frequency. These new instances offer up to 30% higher performance and 19% better price-performance compared to M7a instances, along with 45% more memory bandwidth making them suitable for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8a instances now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8a instances are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) region, powered by 5th generation AMD EPYC processors with frequencies up to 4.5 GHz. These instances offer up to 30% higher performance and 19% better price-performance compared to M7a instances, along with 45% more memory bandwidth, making them suitable for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: AWS Storage Gateway Terraform modules now support Amazon Linux 2023
announcements.summary: AWS Storage Gateway Terraform modules now support Amazon Linux 2023-based deployments, providing enhanced security, reliability, and operational simplicity for Infrastructure as Code provisioning. The updated modules support all gateway types (S3 File Gateway, Tape Gateway, and Volume Gateway) across both Amazon EC2 and VMware environments, with EC2 deployments enforcing IMDSv2 by default for improved security.

announcements.title: Accelerate AI-assisted development with Agent Plugin for AWS Serverless
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the Agent Plugin for AWS Serverless, which integrates with AI coding assistants like Kiro, Claude Code, and Cursor to help developers build, deploy, troubleshoot, and manage serverless applications more efficiently. The plugin packages skills, sub-agents, hooks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into a modular unit that dynamically provides relevant guidance and expertise for serverless development tasks.

announcements.title: AWS Batch now provides AMI status and supports AWS Health Planned Lifecycle Events
announcements.summary: AWS Batch now offers enhanced visibility into compute environments by providing status information for Batch-provided default Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), showing when updates are available. Additionally, AWS Batch now publishes AWS Health Planned Lifecycle Events to help users prepare for and track changes that may affect their batch computing resources.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio launches support for remote connection from Cursor IDE
announcements.summary: AWS has launched support for remote connection from Cursor IDE to Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio through the AWS Toolkit extension. This integration allows data scientists, ML engineers, and developers to use Cursor's AI-powered features like code completion and natural language editing while accessing SageMaker's scalable compute resources. The connection helps streamline the development workflow by combining Cursor's advanced IDE capabilities with Amazon's cloud-based machine learning infrastructure.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds support for Chrome policies and custom root CA
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore has added support for Chrome Enterprise policies and custom root Certificate Authority (CA) certificates for both its Browser and Code Interpreter components. These enhancements allow AI agents to operate within organizations that have strict security requirements and use internal infrastructure with custom certificates. The update includes access to over 100 configurable Chrome policies to help meet enterprise security standards.

announcements.title: AWS Batch now supports quota management and preemption for SageMaker Training jobs
