announcements.summary: AWS Batch now supports quota management and job preemption specifically for SageMaker Training jobs, allowing teams to efficiently allocate and share compute resources across projects. This feature enables intelligent prioritization of business-critical training jobs and automatic preemption of lower-priority workloads when urgent experiments need GPU capacity.

announcements.title: Amazon Route 53 Profiles now supports granular IAM permissions for resource and VPC associations
announcements.summary: Amazon Route 53 Profiles now supports granular IAM permissions that allow administrators to control which users can manage specific resource types and VPC associations within their Profiles. Users can create IAM policies to restrict access to specific operations (associate, disassociate, or update) on individual resource types like private hosted zones, Resolver rules, or DNS Firewall rule groups. Permissions can also be defined based on resource ARNs for more precise access control.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick Now Available in the AWS Tokyo Region
announcements.summary: Amazon Quick, an AI-powered business assistant that helps users quickly answer work questions and take actions without switching applications, is now available in the AWS Tokyo region (ap-northeast-1). This expansion allows Japanese customers to access Amazon Quick's full capabilities while meeting local data sovereignty requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now available with the AWS Free Tier
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is now available on the AWS Free Tier, offering new customers $100 in initial AWS credits plus the opportunity to earn an additional $100 by using services like Amazon RDS. Users with a Free Plan account can quickly create an Aurora PostgreSQL serverless cluster through the RDS Console, CLI, or SDKs using express configuration, enabling database creation and querying within seconds.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now supports creating and connecting to a database in seconds
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL has launched a new express configuration feature that allows users to create and connect to a serverless database cluster in seconds using pre-configured settings. This streamlined setup process significantly reduces the time to first query and accelerates initial database deployment. The express configuration creates clusters outside of a VPC network, with options to modify certain settings during creation and additional settings afterward.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports serverless reinforcement fine-tuning for 12 additional models
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI has expanded its serverless reinforcement fine-tuning capabilities to support 12 additional open-weight models, including various sizes of Qwen, DeepSeek-R1-Distill, and Meta Llama models. This enhancement allows users to customize and fine-tune these models without needing to provision or manage any underlying infrastructure, simplifying the AI model development process.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 I7ie instances now available in additional AWS regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 I7ie instances are now available in seven additional AWS regions including Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Seoul, Melbourne, Thailand), Europe (Zurich, Milan), and Mexico (Central). These instances are designed for storage-intensive workloads and feature 5th Gen Intel Xeon Processors running at 3.2 GHz all-core turbo frequency, delivering up to 40% better compute performance and 20% better price performance compared to I3en instances.

announcements.title: AWS HealthImaging is now available in Europe (London)
announcements.summary: AWS HealthImaging, a HIPAA-eligible service for storing, analyzing, and sharing medical images at petabyte scale, is now available in the AWS Europe (London) Region. The service provides fully managed infrastructure for healthcare providers, life sciences organizations, and software partners to handle medical imaging data. It offers both DICOMWeb APIs for integration with existing applications and AWS-native APIs for cloud-first implementations.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime adds WebRTC support for real-time bidirectional streaming
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime now supports WebRTC in addition to WebSocket protocols, enabling real-time bidirectional streaming between clients and AI agents. This enhancement allows developers to build voice agents for browser and mobile applications with low-latency audio and video streaming using peer-to-peer UDP transport. The WebRTC support enables more natural, real-time conversational experiences for users interacting with AI agents.

announcements.title: Amazon EKS announces 99.99% Service Level Agreement and new 8XL scaling tier for Provisioned Control Plane clusters
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS has upgraded its Service Level Agreement for Provisioned Control Plane clusters from 99.95% to 99.99% uptime. The service is also introducing a new 8XL scaling tier, which is the largest available capacity option for Provisioned Control Plane clusters, allowing customers to select from pre-defined scaling tiers for their cluster's control plane capacity.

announcements.title: AWS Neuron announces support for Dynamic Resource Allocation with Amazon EKS
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the Neuron Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) driver for Amazon EKS, which enables Kubernetes-native hardware-aware scheduling for AWS Trainium-based instances. The driver publishes detailed device attributes directly to the Kubernetes scheduler, allowing for topology-aware placement decisions without requiring custom scheduler extensions. This development simplifies the deployment of AI workloads on Kubernetes by reducing the infrastructure complexity that ML engineers typically need to manage.

announcements.title: Amazon Polly expands Generative TTS engine with 10 new voices, 2 new regions, and Bidirectional Streaming API
announcements.summary: Amazon Polly has launched 10 new highly expressive Generative TTS voices across 8 locales, including American/British English, New Zealand English, Singapore English, French, Italian, German, and Swiss German options. The Generative engine is now also available in two additional AWS regions: Europe (London) and Canada (Central), alongside the introduction of a new Bidirectional Streaming API.

announcements.title: AWS DataSync now supports AWS Secrets Manager for all location types
announcements.summary: AWS DataSync has expanded its AWS Secrets Manager integration to support credential management across all location types, including HDFS, Amazon FSx for Windows File Server, and Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP. Previously, Secrets Manager was only available for select location types, forcing users to input credentials directly through the DataSync API or console. This update enables centralized credential management for all DataSync locations through Secrets Manager.

announcements.title: AWS Firewall Manager launches in AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
announcements.summary: AWS Firewall Manager is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region. The service helps cloud security administrators and site reliability engineers protect applications by automating the configuration and management of firewall rules, reducing manual operational overhead. It enables customers to implement comprehensive defense-in-depth security policies across AWS security services for their applications and workloads.

announcements.title: AWS MCP Server (Preview) now with enhanced monitoring and semantic search capability
announcements.summary: AWS has announced enhancements to its MCP Server (preview) that now includes operational metrics publishing to Amazon CloudWatch and introduces semantic search for Agent SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) discovery. Agent SOPs are pre-built workflows that help AI assistants navigate complex multi-step AWS tasks. These updates provide better visibility into MCP Server usage and offer guided pathways for agents to perform AWS operations, addressing previous limitations in monitoring agent-driven changes.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 Fleet now supports interruptible Capacity Reservations
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 Fleet now supports interruptible Capacity Reservations, allowing customers to specify interruptible Capacity Reservation IDs across Launch Templates when provisioning instances. This feature enables customers to make unused On-Demand Capacity Reservations temporarily available as interruptible reservations within their AWS Organization, improving overall capacity utilization.

announcements.title: AWS adds support for NIXL with EFA to accelerate LLM inference at scale
announcements.summary: AWS has announced support for NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library (NIXL) with Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference on Amazon EC2. This integration improves disaggregated inference serving by increasing KV-cache throughput, reducing inter-token latency, and optimizing memory utilization. The combination enables high-performance, low-latency KV-cache transfer between prefill and decode nodes for more efficient LLM inference at scale.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift supports federated permissions with IAM Identity Center in multiple AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift now supports federated permissions with AWS IAM Identity Center across multiple AWS Regions, allowing you to extend IdC beyond your primary region for better performance and reliability. This enables simplified administration of fine-grained access controls at the table and column level using existing workforce identities across multiple regions.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8gn instances are now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8gn instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors are now available in additional regions including Asia Pacific (Jakarta, Hyderabad, Tokyo), South America (Sao Paulo), and Europe (Zurich). These new instances deliver up to 30% better compute performance compared to the previous Graviton3-based C7gn instances and feature 6th generation AWS Nitro Cards with up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda now supports Availability Zone metadata
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda now provides Availability Zone (AZ) metadata through a new endpoint in the Lambda execution environment, allowing developers to identify which specific AZ their function is running in (e.g., use1-az1). This enables developers to build AZ-aware applications that can make intelligent routing decisions, such as preferring same-AZ endpoints to reduce latency and implement resilience patterns.

announcements.title: AWS Direct Connect announces new location in Sydney, Australia
announcements.summary: AWS has opened a new Direct Connect location at Equinix SY5 in Sydney, Australia, marking the fourth such facility in Sydney and tenth in Australia overall. The location enables private, direct network access to all public AWS Regions (excluding China), AWS GovCloud Regions, and AWS Local Zones. The facility offers dedicated connections at 10 Gbps and 100 Gbps speeds with MACsec encryption.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server adds ability to view and schedule new operating system updates
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server now allows customers to view and schedule operating system updates for RDS-provided engine versions (RPEV), which come with SQL Server pre-installed on an AMI. Customers can see upcoming OS updates and choose to apply them immediately or schedule them for the next maintenance window using RDS Custom APIs. This enhancement gives users more control over when critical OS updates are applied to their SQL Server instances.

announcements.title: Minimax M2.5 and GLM 5 models now available on Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has added two new AI models to its platform: GLM 5 and Minimax M2.5. GLM 5 is a frontier-class large language model specifically designed for complex systems engineering and long-term agentic tasks, featuring capabilities in multi-step reasoning, mathematics, advanced coding, and tool-augmented workflows with long context support for enterprise applications.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i-6TB instances now available in Asia Pacific (Malaysia)
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances with 6TB of memory (u7i-6tb.112xlarge) are now available in the Asia Pacific (Malaysia) region. These 7th generation instances feature custom Intel Xeon Scalable Processors, 6TiB of DDR5 memory, 448 vCPUs, and up to 100 Gbps EBS bandwidth. They are designed to help customers scale transaction processing throughput in fast-growing data environments.

announcements.title: Amazon ECR now supports pull through cache for Chainguard
announcements.summary: Amazon ECR now supports Chainguard as an upstream source for its pull through cache feature, allowing customers to automatically synchronize private Chainguard images with improved security and availability. This enhancement helps customers scale their use of Chainguard images while keeping them in sync with Chainguard's registry without additional manual effort.

announcements.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super now available on Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now offers NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super, an open hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model specifically designed for complex multi-agent AI applications. The model provides fast, cost-efficient inference while maintaining context and accuracy across long, multi-step tasks. Being fully open with accessible weights, datasets, and recipes, it enables easy customization and secure deployment for enterprises and startups.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Access Grants are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Access Grants are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region, allowing organizations to map corporate identities from directories like Microsoft Entra ID or AWS IAM to S3 datasets. This feature enables automated, scalable management of S3 data permissions by granting access based on users' corporate identities.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M6in and M6idn instances are now available in Europe (London) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M6in and M6idn instances are now available in the AWS London Region, offering sixth-generation network-optimized computing powered by 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors. These instances deliver up to 200 Gbps network bandwidth, providing 2x more network performance than comparable fifth-generation instances, making them ideal for network-intensive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8a instances now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8a instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) region, powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with up to 4.5 GHz frequency. These compute-optimized instances deliver up to 30% higher performance and 19% better price-performance compared to C7a instances, with 33% more memory bandwidth making them ideal for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon Inspector expands agentless EC2 scanning and introduces Windows KB-based findings
announcements.summary: Amazon Inspector has expanded its agentless EC2 scanning capabilities to include Windows operating system vulnerability detection, eliminating the need for agents on Windows instances. The enhanced service now provides broader vulnerability detection coverage across various software and applications including WordPress, Apache HTTP Server, Python packages, and Ruby gems. This expansion enables security teams and IT administrators to identify vulnerabilities across a wider range of systems and software without deploying additional agents.

announcements.title: AWS Config launches 75 new managed rules
announcements.summary: AWS Config has launched 75 new managed rules that help organizations govern security, durability, and operational use cases across their AWS environments. These rules can be easily searched, discovered, and enabled directly through AWS Config, and can be applied at both the account and organization level. The new rules extend governance capabilities to services like AWS Amplify, Amazon SageMaker, and Amazon Route 53.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift increases performance for new queries in dashboards and ETL workloads by up to 7x
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has announced performance improvements that accelerate new queries by up to 7x, significantly enhancing response times for BI dashboards and ETL workloads. The enhancement specifically speeds up the SQL query preparation process, benefiting low-latency applications including near real-time analytics, BI dashboards, ETL pipelines, and AI agents. This improvement allows queries to start faster and return results more quickly for better overall performance.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports OpenSearch version 3.5
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports OpenSearch version 3.5, which introduces enhanced agentic AI capabilities, improved search relevance tooling, and better observability features. The update includes agentic conversation memory that captures conversation context and tool reasoning in persistent storage, allowing AI agents to maintain coherent responses across multi-turn conversations.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect expands agentic speech-to-speech voice experiences to the London (Europe) region and adds three new voices
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has expanded its agentic speech-to-speech voice experiences to the London (Europe) region and added three new voices: Pedro (US Spanish), Amy (UK English), and Brian (UK English). These AI agents can understand, reason, and take action across voice and messaging channels to automate both routine and complex customer service tasks.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect voice AI agents now supports 13 new languages
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has expanded its voice AI agent language support by adding 13 new languages, bringing the total to 40 language locales. The new languages include Arabic, Czech, Danish, Dutch (Belgium), various English dialects, German (Switzerland), Icelandic, Romanian, Spanish (Mexico), Turkish, and Welsh. These AI agents can automate routine tasks and handle complex interactions across voice and digital channels using advanced reasoning capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio supports aggregated view of data lineage
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now offers an aggregated view of data lineage that displays all jobs contributing to datasets, providing a complete picture of data transformations and dependencies across the entire lineage graph. This enhancement allows users to quickly identify all upstream sources and downstream consumers of their datasets. Previously, the platform only showed lineage graphs at specific points in time, making this aggregated view a significant improvement for understanding data flow comprehensively.

announcements.title: SageMaker Training Plans now enables extending of existing capacity commitments without workload reconfiguration
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Training Plans now allows users to extend their existing GPU capacity reservations when AI workloads run longer than expected, preventing interruptions to training jobs. Users can extend plans in 1-day increments (up to 14 days) or 7-day increments (up to 182 days/26 weeks) through the API or SageMaker console. This feature eliminates the need to reconfigure workloads when additional training time is required for reserved capacity clusters of up to 64 instances.

announcements.title: AWS Blu Insights is now AWS Transform for mainframe refactor
announcements.summary: AWS has rebranded and integrated AWS Blu Insights into AWS Transform, creating a unified platform that supports all three mainframe modernization approaches: refactor, replatform, and reimagine. The service now offers code transformation at no cost, eliminating the previous pricing model based on lines of code. Customers can now launch and manage mainframe refactoring projects directly through the AWS Transform console.

announcements.title: Amazon MSK expands Express brokers to Africa (Cape Town) and Asia Pacific (Taipei) regions
announcements.summary: Amazon MSK has expanded Express brokers availability to two new regions: Africa (Cape Town) and Asia Pacific (Taipei). Express brokers are a new broker type that delivers up to 3x more throughput per broker, scales up to 20x faster, and reduces recovery time by 90% compared to standard Apache Kafka brokers. These brokers come pre-configured with Kafka best practices and support all Kafka APIs.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime now supports shell command execution
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime has introduced a new InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand API that enables direct execution of shell commands within running AgentCore Runtime sessions. The feature allows developers to send commands, stream real-time output over HTTP/2, and receive exit codes without needing custom command execution logic in their containers. This enhancement is particularly useful for AI agents that need to perform deterministic operations like running tests, installing dependencies, or executing git commands.

announcements.title: Amazon Corretto 26 is now generally available
announcements.summary: Amazon Corretto 26, a free production-ready OpenJDK distribution, is now generally available for download on Linux, Windows, and macOS with support through October 2026. This Feature Release includes HTTP/3 protocol support for faster and more efficient networking in Java applications, along with ahead-of-time object caching capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS enhancements for SQL Server Developer Edition
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for SQL Server Developer Edition now supports Additional Storage Volumes, Resource Governor, and SQL Server 2019. SQL Server Developer Edition provides all Enterprise edition functionality without license charges, making it ideal for development and testing environments. This enhancement expands storage and resource management capabilities for non-production SQL Server workloads on AWS.

announcements.title: Simplified permissions for Amazon S3 Tables and Iceberg materialized views
announcements.summary: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports IAM-based authorization for Amazon S3 Tables and Apache Iceberg materialized views, allowing you to define all necessary permissions across storage, catalog, and query engines in a single IAM policy. This simplifies integration with AWS Analytics services like Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Glue, while maintaining the option to upgrade to AWS Lake Formation when needed.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock is now available in Asia Pacific (New Zealand)
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock, AWS's fully managed generative AI service, is now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) region. The service allows customers to easily build and scale AI applications using foundation models from leading companies including AI21 Labs, Anthropic, Cohere, Meta, Mistral AI, OpenAI, Stability AI, and Amazon. This regional expansion gives New Zealand-based customers local access to high-performing large language models and AI development tools.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch introduces organization-wide EC2 detailed monitoring enablement
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch now enables customers to automatically activate EC2 detailed monitoring across their entire AWS Organization through new enablement rules in CloudWatch Ingestion. These rules can automatically enable 1-minute interval metrics collection for both existing and newly launched EC2 instances that match the specified criteria. This feature ensures consistent and comprehensive monitoring coverage across all EC2 instances within an organization without manual configuration.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs now supports log ingestion using HTTP-based protocol
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs now supports HTTP-based log ingestion through multiple protocols including HTTP Log Collector (HLC), ND-JSON, Structured JSON, and OpenTelemetry (OTEL) with bearer token authentication. This enhancement enables customers to send logs from third-party or packaged software where AWS SDK integration isn't possible, providing greater flexibility for diverse logging environments.

announcements.title: SageMaker HyperPod now supports idle resource sharing for dynamic cluster utilization
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod has introduced dynamic resource sharing that allows teams to borrow unused compute capacity from shared clusters beyond their guaranteed quotas. Administrators can set borrowing limits for specific resources like accelerators, vCPU, or memory to ensure fair distribution across teams. This feature addresses underutilization challenges commonly faced in shared compute clusters for generative AI workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon Neptune now supports reading S3 data using openCyper
announcements.summary: Amazon Neptune now supports reading data directly from Amazon S3 within openCypher queries through the new `neptune.read()` procedure. This feature allows customers to federate with external S3 data without needing to load it into Neptune first, eliminating traditional multi-step workflow requirements. Organizations can now perform real-time graph analytics by dynamically combining S3-stored data with their existing Neptune graphs.

announcements.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 Now Supports Expanded Multi-Node Cluster Configurations
announcements.summary: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 Enterprise edition now supports expanded multi-node cluster configurations with up to 15 total nodes, including 1-4 writer/reader nodes and up to 13 dedicated reader-only nodes. This enhancement enables organizations to scale their time-series databases for demanding production workloads that require high read throughput and high availability.

announcements.title: Announcing AWS Partner Central agents to accelerate co-sell
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of AWS Partner Central agents, AI-powered capabilities built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that help accelerate co-selling between AWS and its partners. These agents work alongside partner sales teams to shorten sales cycles and simplify funding access. Partners can access these capabilities through the AWS console or programmatically via Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate them into their existing systems.

announcements.title: Amazon SimpleDB now supports exporting domain data to Amazon S3
announcements.summary: Amazon SimpleDB now supports direct export of domain data to Amazon S3 buckets in JSON format, with exports running in the background without affecting database performance. The export tool includes cross-region and cross-account capabilities, multiple encryption options, and flexible S3 configuration to support data migration, archival, and compliance requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now enables agents to forward email contacts to external email addresses
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now allows agents to forward email contacts to external email addresses and distribution lists directly from their workspace while maintaining ownership and full communication history of the original contact. This feature enables agents to easily involve back-office teams, experts, and partners in customer communications while serving as the primary point of contact for customers.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime now supports the AG-UI protocol
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime now supports the Agent-User Interaction (AG-UI) protocol, an open, event-based standard for AI agent communication. This enables developers to deploy AG-UI servers that provide real-time, responsive agent experiences while AgentCore Runtime manages authentication, session isolation, and scaling automatically. The integration allows developers to focus on building interactive frontends rather than handling infrastructure concerns.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals adds new SLO capabilities
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals has introduced three new Service Level Objective (SLO) capabilities: SLO Recommendations, Service-Level SLOs, and SLO Performance Report. These console-based features help customers monitor and improve application performance across AWS services like EC2, ECS, and Lambda by automatically collecting application data. The new capabilities address the previous challenge where customers had to manually set SLO thresholds without data-driven guidance.

announcements.title: Accelerate serverless application development with new SAM Kiro power
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the SAM Kiro power, which integrates AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) capabilities with AI agent-assisted development in the Kiro platform. This new tool allows developers to build, deploy, and manage serverless applications directly in their local environment with AI assistance. The SAM Kiro power dynamically provides relevant guidance and development expertise to AI agents for building serverless applications more efficiently.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8a instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Tokyo) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8a instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) Region, featuring 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with up to 4.5 GHz frequency. These instances deliver up to 30% higher performance and 19% better price-performance compared to R7a instances, along with 45% more memory bandwidth, making them ideal for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8azn instances are now available in US East (Ohio) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8azn instances are now available in the US East (Ohio) Region, featuring fifth-generation AMD EPYC processors with the highest maximum CPU frequency of 5GHz available in the cloud. These general-purpose instances deliver up to 2x compute performance compared to M5zn instances and 24% higher performance than M8a instances, while also providing significantly higher memory bandwidth.

announcements.title: Amazon MSK announces support for Standard brokers Graviton-3 instance in Africa (Cape Town) region
announcements.summary: Amazon MSK now supports Standard brokers using AWS Graviton3-based M7g instances in the Africa (Cape Town) region. These M7g instances provide up to 24% compute cost savings and up to 29% higher read/write throughput compared to M5 instances. Users can create new clusters with M7g brokers or upgrade existing M5 clusters through the Amazon MSK console.

announcements.title: AWS Network Firewall Launch in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud
announcements.summary: AWS Network Firewall is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, enabling European customers in highly regulated industries and government agencies to protect sensitive workloads while maintaining compliance with EU data protection regulations. This launch specifically targets organizations with strict data sovereignty requirements who need advanced network security capabilities within Europe's regulatory framework.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 Hpc8a instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and AWS GovCloud (US-West)
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 Hpc8a instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) regions. These new instances are powered by 5th generation AMD EPYC processors with up to 4.5GHz frequency, delivering up to 40% higher performance and 25% better price performance compared to the previous Hpc7a instances. The Hpc8a instances are designed to accelerate compute-intensive workloads while helping customers optimize costs.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda Managed Instances now supports Rust
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda Managed Instances now supports Rust, allowing developers to run high-performance Rust functions on Lambda-managed EC2 instances while retaining Lambda's operational simplicity. This enables performance-critical applications to run without the complexity of server management. Lambda Managed Instances provides access to specialized compute configurations with latest-generation processors and high-bandwidth networking.

announcements.title: OpenSearch UI supports Cross Account Data Access to OpenSearch domains
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now enables cross-account data access, allowing users to query and build dashboards using data from OpenSearch domains across different AWS accounts within a single UI application. This eliminates the need to switch endpoints or replicate data when working with domains in the same region. The feature is available for both public and VPC-hosted OpenSearch domains.

announcements.title: New LZA MCP Server for AI-assisted configuration management
announcements.summary: AWS has released an open source LZA MCP Server that allows organizations to manage Landing Zone Accelerator deployments through natural language conversations with AI assistants. The server includes 20 specialized tools designed to streamline previously manual configuration tasks such as searching documentation, managing configurations, and monitoring pipelines. This innovation enables AI-assisted configuration management, making LZA deployments more accessible and efficient through conversational interfaces.

announcements.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk launches Deployments tab with in-progress deployment logs
announcements.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk has launched a new Deployments tab that provides customers with a consolidated view of deployment history and real-time progress tracking through step-by-step logs. Previously, users had to wait for deployments to complete and correlate information across multiple sources to understand deployment status. This new feature centralizes deployment status, events, and detailed logs in a single interface within the environment dashboard.

announcements.title: AWS Private CA Connector for SCEP now supports AWS PrivateLink
announcements.summary: AWS Private CA Connector for SCEP now supports AWS PrivateLink, enabling clients to request certificates directly within their VPC without using the public internet. This enhancement allows users to create VPC endpoints for private connectivity to their SCEP connector, keeping all certificate enrollment traffic securely within the AWS network.

announcements.title: AWS CDK Mixins is now generally available
announcements.summary: AWS CDK Mixins is now generally available, allowing developers to add composable and reusable abstractions to any AWS construct (L1, L2, or custom) without rebuilding existing infrastructure code. This new feature is included in the aws-cdk-lib package and works across all construct types, providing flexibility to apply abstractions as needed. CDK Mixins eliminates the previous limitation where teams had to choose between immediate access to new AWS services and higher-level abstractions.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory announces streaming notifications for long-term memory
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now provides streaming notifications for long-term memory updates, eliminating the need for developers to poll for changes. The service streams updates directly to Amazon Kinesis whenever memory records are created or modified, enabling real-time triggering of downstream workflows. This enhancement allows AI agents to better leverage extracted insights from past interactions to deliver more personalized user experiences.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in Europe (Ireland) and Europe (London) regions, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These instances offer up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, delivering the highest performance among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: AWS Glue zero-ETL integrations with Amazon DynamoDB as the source support new configurations
announcements.summary: AWS Glue zero-ETL integrations with Amazon DynamoDB now support configurable change data capture (CDC) refresh intervals ranging from 15 minutes to 6 days, allowing users to customize how frequently data changes are captured. The enhancement also includes on-demand data ingestion capability, enabling immediate data ingestion when needed. These new features bring DynamoDB zero-ETL integrations to feature parity with other AWS data source integrations.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces now supports Microsoft Windows Server 2025
announcements.summary: AWS has announced new Amazon WorkSpaces bundles powered by Microsoft Windows Server 2025, available for both WorkSpaces Personal and WorkSpaces Core. These new bundles allow customers to access the latest Windows server features and run applications like Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise that require newer Windows versions. Previous Windows Server versions (2016, 2019, and 2022) continue to be available alongside the new 2025 option.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 introduces account regional namespaces for general purpose buckets
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 now offers account regional namespaces for general purpose buckets, allowing users to create buckets in their own reserved namespace without needing globally unique names. This feature enables predictable bucket naming across multiple AWS Regions and simplifies workloads that require dedicated buckets per customer, team, or dataset. The change eliminates the common challenge of finding available bucket names and ensures desired names are always available within your account's namespace.

announcements.title: AWS Backup adds logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon EKS
announcements.summary: AWS Backup has extended logically air-gapped vault support to Amazon EKS clusters, allowing organizations to store immutable, encrypted backup copies that are isolated and locked by default. These vaults enable secure cross-account backup sharing within AWS Organizations and support direct restore capabilities to minimize recovery time during data loss events.

announcements.title: Amazon Neptune Database is now available in Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) region
announcements.summary: Amazon Neptune Database is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) region, allowing users to create Neptune clusters using various instance types including R5, R5d, R6g, R6i, X2iedn, T4g, and T3. Neptune is AWS's fully managed graph database service designed for building applications that work with highly connected datasets using Apache TinkerPop Gremlin or openCypher query languages.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8id instances are now available in Europe (Spain)
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8id instances, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors, are now available in the Europe (Spain) region. These instances offer up to 384 vCPUs, 768GiB of memory, and 22.8TB of NVMe SSD storage, delivering up to 43% higher performance and 3.3x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation C6id instances. The new instances provide up to 46% better performance for I/O intensive database workloads and up to 30% faster query results for I/O intensive applications.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8gd and M8gd instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8gd and M8gd instances are now available in additional AWS regions - C8gd in South America (São Paulo) and M8gd in Europe (Ireland). These instances are powered by AWS Graviton4 processors and offer up to 11.4 TB of local NVMe SSD storage, delivering up to 30% better performance compared to Graviton3-based instances and up to 40% higher performance for I/O intensive database workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R7gd instances are now available in South America (Sao Paulo) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R7gd instances, powered by AWS Graviton3 processors with up to 3.8 TB of local NVMe SSD storage, are now available in the South America (São Paulo) region. These instances are optimized for memory-intensive workloads including open-source databases, in-memory caches, and real-time big data analytics that require high-speed, low-latency local storage access.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights on-demand analysis now available in AWS Govcloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights' on-demand analysis feature is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) regions. This monitoring and diagnostics solution helps database administrators and developers optimize database performance by providing comprehensive visibility into database metrics, query analysis, and resource utilization patterns using machine learning to identify performance bottlenecks.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now provides integrated workflows for managers to coach agents
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has introduced integrated agent coaching workflows that allow contact center managers to provide targeted feedback directly within the Connect interface. When managers spot improvement opportunities through evaluation scorecards, they can immediately create coaching plans using specific customer interaction examples. This enables managers to give timely, context-specific guidance to agents, such as highlighting interactions where an agent demonstrated strong problem-solving skills but could improve on showing customer empathy.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances are now available in additional AWS regions, with 8TB memory instances (u7i-8tb.112xlarge) launching in Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) and 12TB memory instances (u7i-12tb.224xlarge) in Europe (Spain). These 7th generation instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon Scalable Processors (Sapphire Rapids) and feature high-capacity DDR5 memory to support large-scale transaction processing workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now lets you select different From email addresses when sending emails
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now allows agents to select different "From" email addresses when sending outbound emails or replying to inbound messages, ensuring the correct brand identity is used for customer interactions. Administrators can configure multiple sender addresses per queue, enabling agents to choose the appropriate email address based on their current queue. This feature is particularly beneficial for contact centers managing multiple brands or business units.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now provides case data in analytics data lake
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now includes case data in its analytics data lake, enabling users to create custom reports and analyze case-related trends alongside other Connect analytics. This integration allows direct use of Amazon Athena and Amazon QuickSight to analyze metrics like case volume by type, agent performance across shifts, and contact sentiment without requiring complex data pipeline development.

announcements.title: AWS Backup expands support for Amazon RDS Multi-AZ clusters to 17 Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Backup has expanded its support for Amazon RDS Multi-AZ clusters to 17 additional regions across Asia Pacific, Europe, South America, Africa, and Canada. This expansion provides comprehensive data protection capabilities including automated lifecycle management and immutable backups with AWS Backup Vault Lock for RDS Multi-AZ clusters in these new regions.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime now supports stateful MCP server features
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime has expanded its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support to include stateful features like elicitation, sampling, and progress notifications, in addition to existing resources, prompts, and tools capabilities. These new features enable MCP servers to interactively collect user input during tool execution, request LLM-generated content from clients, and provide real-time updates for long-running operations.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports observability of First Token Latency and Quota Consumption
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now provides enhanced observability through two new CloudWatch metrics: TimeToFirstToken and EstimatedTPMQuotaUsage. TimeToFirstToken measures the latency between sending a request and receiving the first token for streaming APIs, while EstimatedTPMQuotaUsage tracks quota consumption. These metrics give developers better visibility into inference performance and resource usage for their generative AI applications.

announcements.title: AWS Builder ID now supports Sign in with GitHub and Amazon
announcements.summary: AWS Builder ID has added GitHub and Amazon as new social login options, joining the existing Google and Apple sign-in capabilities. This allows developers to access AWS applications like AWS Builder Center, AWS Training and Certification, and Kiro using their existing GitHub or Amazon credentials without needing separate AWS login credentials.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect enhances AI-powered predictive insights
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has enhanced its AI-powered predictive insights with significant scalability and accuracy improvements, including support for up to 40 million product catalog items (an 8X increase) and up to 14% better model accuracy. The enhancements build on five recommendation algorithms from re:Invent 2025 and now include integration with message templates for trigger-based campaigns. These improvements help businesses deliver more proactive and personalized customer experiences at scale.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now supports conversational analytics for email
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now supports conversational analytics for email contacts, allowing contact center managers to automatically categorize emails, redact PII, and generate contact summaries. This new capability enables managers to quickly identify trends, maintain compliance by protecting sensitive data, and reduce time spent on agent performance reviews. The feature works automatically when customers send emails about issues like account problems.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect introduces AI-powered manager assistance (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has launched a preview of an AI-powered assistant that allows contact center managers to instantly query over 150 operational metrics using natural language, eliminating hours of manual data gathering. The assistant can analyze historical data across areas like agent scheduling, self-service experiences, and performance evaluations, while also diagnosing underlying operational issues. This tool enables managers to get quick answers to operational questions and insights in seconds rather than spending time on manual analysis.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports in-place volume increases for all volume sizes
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now allows in-place volume size increases for all storage volumes, removing the previous 3 TiB limitation. This enhancement enables users to scale storage capacity of any size without requiring disruptive blue/green deployments, making it faster and easier to expand storage when needed.

announcements.title: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver is now generally available
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver, an anycast DNS resolver that provides secure and reliable DNS resolution for authorized clients from anywhere on the internet. The service is now available across 30 AWS Regions with support for both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic, expanding from its initial preview launch at re:Invent 2025 in 11 regions. Global Resolver enables organizations to resolve both public internet domains and private domains for their authorized clients.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs announces increased query concurrency and API limits
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs has increased its query concurrency limit from 30 to 100 concurrent queries per account and raised API limits to 10 StartQuery and GetQueryResults calls per second per account/per-region. These enhancements allow customers to support more simultaneous users and execute more concurrent queries using the Logs Insights Query Language, improving overall dashboard and query performance.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick Suite launches User Preferences for chat personalization
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight has launched User Preferences, a new feature that allows users to personalize their chat experience within the platform. Users can now customize their Chat panel layout (expanded or collapsed by default), select a default chat agent, and set a preferred knowledge scope for My Assistant. The system automatically remembers user settings and resumes from their last configuration.

announcements.title: Amazon Cognito is now available in Asia Pacific (Taipei) and Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Cognito, AWS's identity and access management service, has expanded to two new Asia Pacific regions: Taipei and New Zealand. This expansion brings all Cognito features and tiers to these regions, enabling customers to quickly implement secure authentication and access control for users, AI agents, and microservices.

announcements.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports post-quantum digital certificates
announcements.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere now supports FIPS 204 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Standard (ML-DSA), a quantum-resistant digital signature algorithm standardized by NIST. This enhancement helps protect against potential threats from large-scale quantum computers for customers who use X.509 certificates to authenticate workloads to AWS.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G7e instances now available in Asia Pacific (Seoul) and Europe (Spain) regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 G7e instances powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs are now available in Asia Pacific (Seoul) and Europe (Spain) regions. These instances deliver up to 2.3x better inference performance compared to G6e instances and are optimized for deploying large language models, agentic AI, multimodal generative AI, and physical AI models. G7e instances also provide the highest performance for spatial computing and related workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift introduces reusable templates for COPY operations
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has introduced reusable templates for COPY operations that allow users to store and reuse frequently used COPY parameters. This feature eliminates the need to manually specify formatting parameters for each operation, maintaining consistency across data ingestion processes. The templates reduce time and effort required for executing COPY commands by streamlining repetitive data loading tasks.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift introduces new array functions for semi-structured data processing
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has introduced nine new array functions (including ARRAY_CONTAINS, ARRAY_DISTINCT, ARRAY_SORT, and others) that enable users to efficiently search, compare, sort, and transform semi-structured data stored in the SUPER data type. These functions allow developers to perform complex array operations directly within SQL queries, eliminating the need to write custom PartiQL SQL logic that was previously required for such tasks.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8g instances now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8g instances are now available in three additional AWS regions: Middle East (UAE), Mexico (Central), and Europe (Zurich). These instances are powered by AWS Graviton4 processors and deliver up to 30% better performance compared to Graviton3-based instances. The R8g instances are optimized for memory-intensive workloads like databases, in-memory caches, and real-time big data analytics.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift Serverless now maintains datashare permissions during restore
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift Serverless now automatically preserves datashare permissions when restoring a snapshot to the same namespace, eliminating the need for manual re-configuration. This enhancement streamlines data sharing workflows by removing the previous requirement for administrators to manually re-grant permissions to consumer clusters and recreate consumer databases after a restore operation.

announcements.title: Multi-party approval now supports approval team baselining
announcements.summary: AWS Multi-party approval (MPA) now includes approval team baselining, which allows MPA administrators to run test approvals to verify their approval teams are properly configured and responsive. This new feature helps prevent approval teams from becoming unresponsive due to issues like staff turnover, incorrect approver selection, or reduced engagement. The capability enables administrators and security teams to proactively validate their approval configurations before using them for critical operations.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds light mode support for IAM-based domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports light mode for IAM-based domains, allowing customers to choose between dark and light visual themes based on their preferences. This update improves readability in bright environments and gives users full control over their development environment's appearance.

announcements.title: Database Savings Plans now supports Amazon OpenSearch Service and Amazon Neptune Analytics
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded Database Savings Plans to include Amazon OpenSearch Service and Amazon Neptune Analytics, allowing customers to save up to 35% on these services. The savings plans require a one-year commitment to consistent usage (measured in $/hour) with no upfront payment and automatically apply to eligible serverless and provisioned instances across different configurations.

announcements.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk now offers AI-powered environment analysis
announcements.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk has introduced AI-powered environment analysis that automatically identifies root causes and provides recommended solutions for environment health issues. The feature leverages Amazon Bedrock to analyze recent events, instance health data, and logs when problems occur. This enhancement helps developers and operations teams diagnose and resolve issues more quickly without manual log review.

announcements.title: AWS Shield network security director findings are now available in AWS Security Hub
announcements.summary: AWS Shield's network security director (currently in preview) now integrates with AWS Security Hub to surface its findings. The network security director identifies missing or misconfigured network security services like AWS WAF, VPC security groups, and VPC network ACLs across AWS Organizations and provides remediation recommendations. These findings are now accessible within Security Hub's console, including in the Inventory section.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 I8ge instances now generally available in Europe (Ireland) AWS region.
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 I8ge instances in the Europe (Ireland) region, designed for storage-intensive workloads. These instances feature 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors (3.2 GHz all-core turbo) and provide up to 40% better compute performance and 20% better price performance compared to I3en instances. The I8ge instances offer up to 120TB of local NVMe storage density, which is the highest available in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service introduces capacity optimized blue/green deployments
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service has introduced a Capacity Optimized option for blue/green deployments that allows domain updates to proceed even when there isn't enough available instance capacity for a full parallel environment. The new approach performs updates in incremental batches rather than creating a complete duplicate environment, significantly reducing the number of additional instances required during the deployment process.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon Connect Health, Agentic AI Built for Healthcare
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Health is now generally available, offering specialized AI agents designed to streamline healthcare workflows and reduce administrative burden for medical organizations. The platform includes five AI agents that help patients access care faster while freeing up clinicians from paperwork to focus more on patient care. This purpose-built healthcare solution integrates with existing systems to improve both patient engagement and point-of-care processes across the healthcare continuum.

announcements.title: AWS HealthLake announces data transformation agent for automated CCDA-to-FHIR data conversion (Preview)
announcements.summary: AWS HealthLake has launched a preview of its data transformation agent, an AI-powered tool that automatically converts legacy CCDA clinical documents into FHIR R4 format in days rather than months. This capability enables healthcare organizations to quickly transform their clinical data into queryable FHIR resources within AWS HealthLake, supporting use cases like longitudinal patient records, population health analytics, and clinical data exchange.

announcements.title: Accelerate Lambda durable functions development with new Kiro power
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the Lambda durable functions Kiro power, which integrates Lambda durable function development capabilities into Kiro's agentic AI development platform. This new feature enables developers to build resilient, long-running multi-step applications and AI workflows more efficiently through AI agent-assisted development in their local environment. The AI agent provides dynamic guidance and development expertise, including best practices for replay models and other durable function concepts.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8g instances now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8g instances, powered by AWS Graviton4 processors, are now available in five additional regions: Africa (Cape Town), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Europe (Milan, Zurich), and Canada West (Calgary). These general-purpose instances deliver up to 30% better performance compared to Graviton3-based instances and are designed for workloads like application servers, microservices, gaming servers, and caching fleets.

announcements.title: AWS simplifies IAM role creation and setup in service workflows
announcements.summary: AWS has introduced a streamlined IAM role creation feature that allows users to create and configure IAM roles directly within service workflows through a new panel, eliminating the need to switch between browser tabs. This enhancement simplifies the process of setting up secure cross-service connections that use temporary credentials instead of hardcoded access keys. The feature is integrated into console tasks that require role configuration, making IAM role setup more efficient and user-friendly.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now provides comprehensive observability for Restricted Instance Groups
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod has introduced comprehensive observability features for Restricted Instance Groups (RIG), specifically designed for teams training foundation models with Nova Forge. This new capability provides automated monitoring and a unified view of GPU performance, system health, network throughput, and Kubernetes cluster state, eliminating the need for manual metric collection and correlation across the infrastructure stack.

announcements.title: Amazon Lightsail now offers OpenClaw, a private self-hosted AI assistant
announcements.summary: Amazon Lightsail now offers OpenClaw, a private self-hosted AI assistant that can be deployed on your own cloud infrastructure with built-in security features. The service includes pre-configured security controls, sandboxed agent sessions, one-click HTTPS access, and device pairing authentication for secure deployment. This allows users to run their own AI assistant privately without complex manual configuration.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion now supports Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus as a sink
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion now supports Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus as a sink, enabling customers to build fully managed, end-to-end metrics ingestion pipelines without custom forwarding infrastructure. This allows customers to manage their entire metrics ingestion workflow using the same pipeline infrastructure they already use for logs and traces, providing flexibility to route different observability signals to their optimal destinations.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion now supports unified ingestion endpoint for OpenTelemetry data
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion now offers a unified ingestion endpoint that can accept all three OpenTelemetry observability signals (logs, metrics, and traces) through a single pipeline. This eliminates the previous requirement for customers to create and manage three separate pipelines for each signal type. The new capability simplifies pipeline architecture and reduces operational overhead for organizations using OpenTelemetry data.
